{{Quote|We agree that the time for diplomacy and politics has passed. It is now time for action&hellip; Therefore let this be an official declaration of rebellion! Today, we all vow to change the galaxy, and one day the galaxy will indeed be free! |Bail Organa, during the Declaration of Rebellion|<ref name="Force Unleashed" />}}
The '''Galactic Civil War''' ([[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]]), also known as the '''Imperial–Alliance War''', and as the '''Republic–Empire War''' by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]] during the later phase of the conflict, and later the '''First Galactic Civil War''' by [[43 ABY]], was a major [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict fought primarily between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The Alliance was a rebel faction dedicated to the restoration of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the government that the Empire had supplanted at the culmination of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].

The origins of the conflict could be traced to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the final days of the Old Republic, sometime after the Clone Wars, where dissenting and prominent Senators, such as [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] and [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], secretly opposed the powers and authority that [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] continued to accumulate under the guise of security and wartime measures.

The war did not begin in its real sense, that of an Alliance against the Empire with its goals and ideals laid out for the galaxy, until nearly two decades after the rise of the Empire, when various Rebel leaders signed the [[Corellian Treaty]] and issued the [[Declaration of Rebellion/Legends|Declaration of Rebellion]]. Likewise, several Imperial citizens, despite the Empire's atrocities, ended up siding with the Empire, as they were reluctant to join a group similar to the Separatists from the Clone Wars. Initially, the Empire, especially Palpatine, did not consider the Alliance a significant threat, but rather a political tool to further consolidate power that would eventually lead to the [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|dissolution]] of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] and a massive, unprecedented military build-up. Resistance was galvanized after the Empire [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|obliterated]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] for Rebel sympathies, and after [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] destroyed the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] at the fateful [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Thereafter, the threat posed by the Alliance became real to the Empire, and more serious measures were drafted to restore Imperial control over the galaxy.

The decisive moment came at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], when the Alliance, against overwhelming odds, defeated the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] and destroyed the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]], killing [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine, [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and some of the best minds in the [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial High Command]]. From there, the Empire gradually decayed and fragmented, and despite resurgences under [[Ysanne Isard]], [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], a [[Essence transfer|revived]] Emperor Palpatine, and Admiral [[Natasi Daala|Daala]], over a period of fifteen years it was reduced to a mere [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|remnant]] of its former self, while the Alliance evolved and grew into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Peace between the two warring factions was realized in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]] with the signing of the [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty|Bastion Accords]] between Grand Admiral [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] and [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Ponc Gavrisom]], ending over two decades of constant struggle. The Empire continued to exist as an autonomous entity in the years succeeding the war's end, and would eventually enter an alliance with its former enemy during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], and [[Fel Empire|emerge]] as the galaxy's leading government over [[130 ABY|one hundred years later]], seemingly bringing history back full-circle; however, the exploits of the Alliance and the New Republic were not forgotten, and the galaxy was still very different from what it had been during the Empire's reign.

==The origins of the Galactic Civil War==
===Disturbance in the Senate===
[[File:Sithdelscener1pic2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], [[Delegation of 2000|among others]], discuss the formation of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].]]
{{Quote|Some things are better left unsaid.|[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]|<ref name="Episode III novel">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>}}
The emergence of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was brought about by decades of engineering, manipulation, and deceit, masterminded by the cunning and elusive [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], and carried out by his various apprentices and willing (and not-so-willing) agents and puppets. Under the guise of the charismatic [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] Palpatine of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], Sidious took full advantage of the corruption and inefficiencies in the Republic bureaucracy to have himself elected [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]].<ref name="Episode I">{{Film|I}}</ref> Once in office, Palpatine engineered the galaxywide [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], secretly controlling both the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], as a means to further draw powers to his office. Citing special emergency wartime powers and mandates required to maintain security against the Separatist threat, Palpatine accrued autocratic power over the Republic.<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref> At the war's end, Palpatine did not relinquish his powers, instead instigating the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] by fabricating evidence that the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] had attempted to [[Showdown on Coruscant|assassinate him]]. Palpatine [[Declaration of a New Order|declared]] a [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] and announced the creation of the Galactic Empire to much applause from the Senate, the culmination of the [[Order of the Sith Lords]]' thousand-year [[Grand Plan/Legends|Grand Plan]] to seize control of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref>
<div style="float:right">[[File:84PalpatineSpeechFinal.jpg|thumb|right|170px|The self-proclaimed [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] speaks before the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], [[Declaration of a New Order|announcing]] the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].]]</div>
Taking the title of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]], Palpatine set out to establish his authoritarian regime and end his Order's millennia-old feud with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] with the total annihilation of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Palpatine used the "Jedi Rebellion" as his means of turning public opinion against the Jedi, allowing him to enact [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], a secret contingency order that had [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] turn their weapons on their Jedi commanders. Of the several thousand Jedi in the galaxy, very few survived the execution of Order 66 and the subsequent Great Jedi Purge in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], most notably [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].<ref name="Episode III" />

During this tumultuous time, two children, the offspring of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], were born. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Skywalker]] would grow up to lead the Alliance against the Empire and become heroes on their own right; at the time, however, they were separated at birth to escape the wrath of their father, Anakin, who had transformed into Palpatine's third apprentice, [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader. Leia was adopted by [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], and Luke was cared for by his family on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Beru Whitesun Lars/Legends|Beru]] and [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]].<ref name="Episode III" /> As [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]],<ref name="kenner" /> Vader became Palpatine's chief enforcer and carried out his will with terrifying results; he hunted down and killed the remaining Jedi and stomped insurgency, all the while unaware that his children were alive, assuming they had died with his wife on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="Episode III novel" />

With the Empire firmly established, [[Imperialization/Legends|Imperialization]] began throughout the galaxy. The Senate was reorganized into the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]], its powers and influence reduced as to become nothing more than a rubber-stamp assembly.<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> Many Senators were all too willing to allow the Empire to come to pass, as many were under Palpatine's influence or saw it as necessary to secure galactic peace after the events of the Clone Wars. Much of the Galactic populace even saw the early Galactic Empire as an improvement on the Old Republic, particularly following the celebrated [[Reconquest of the Rim]] from [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] to [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], which in years to come many Imperial Loyalists would remember fondly as the final removal of Separatists and criminals and the long-overdue restoration of the rule of law in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Warfare" />

A few Senators, however, began to sow the seeds of dissent that would grow into the Rebel Alliance in the years to come; Bail Organa and [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] were some such Senators, including the late Amidala, who urged patience in defying Palpatine's regime. If they acted too quickly, too overtly, Palpatine would crush them,<ref name="Episode III novel" /> and lingering fears of Separatism and disorder meant that it would take nearly twenty years for organized resistance against the Empire to be realized. While Organa and Mothma planned their resistance in a [[Cantham House Meetings|series of meetings]] at [[Cantham House/Legends|Cantham House]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], during this time Palpatine and his cabal had nearly free-reign in instituting the various new changes to the galaxy. [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentric]] [[High Human Culture/Legends|policies]] became prominent, advocating human supremacy.<ref name="NEC" /> Some species, such as the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], [[Yuzzem]], and [[Lurrian]]s were reclassified as non-sentient and subjected to [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] (or "domestication," as Imperial policy officially stated). State-sponsored terrorism soon became a policy of the Empire, with such notions as the concept of rule through fear, popularized by then-[[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin's]] [[Tarkin Doctrine/Legends|Doctrine]].<ref name="Episode IV" /> Examples such as the pacification of the [[Nembus sector/Legends|Nembus sector]] and the [[Kwymar Suppressions/Legends|Kwymar Suppressions]] exemplified this brutal approach to stifling dissent in the Empire.<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook" /><ref name="Hunt">''[[The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale]]''</ref> Finally, the [[Ghorman Massacre/Legends|Ghorman Massacre]] and the very concept of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] made it clear that the Empire was willing to use any means necessary to maintain its power and control over the galaxy, with no regard towards sentient rights. But the Empire's own disregard for its citizens and implementation of the Tarkin Doctrine would prove to be its undoing, as the sheer oppressiveness of the Imperial regime enraged many citizens, spreading dissent like wildfire.

===Ferus Olin's adventures===
When the Empire subjugated the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]] in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], former [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] [[Ferus Olin]] started an underground resistance movement by forming the group known as [[The Eleven]]. Eventually, Imperial forces captured Olin and his business partner [[Roan Lands]] and imprisoned them in the Empire's garrison/prison facility in [[Ussa]]. But Olin escaped to go into hiding. The resistance movement had such an impact on the [[Bellassan]]s that nearly all of Ussa became devoted to protecting him, a fact that greatly displeased [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Malorum]], the chief of security in Ussa.<ref name="LastoftheJedi">''[[Star Wars: The Last of the Jedi]]''</ref>

Obi-Wan Kenobi eventually tracked down Ferus and decided to help him. Not long after Obi-Wan located Ferus, Malorum issued [[Order 37 on Bellassa|Contingency Order 37]]. Mass arrests were made in Ussa when this order was issued, and an ultimatum was issued over the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]]: if Ferus wasn't turned in within 48 hours after Order 37 was issued, all of the civilians would be executed. Though Ferus planned to give himself up, his safehouse was discovered by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and [[D'harhan]], a pair of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] in Malorum's employ. Ferus and Obi-Wan managed to evade the bounty hunters and return to Ussa to devise a plan to rescue to civilians with the other members of the Eleven. The plan succeeded, but Obi-Wan and Ferus were exposed, and they, along with a boy named [[Trever Flume]], fled Bellassa.<ref name="LastoftheJedi" />

Ferus and Obi-Wan eventually split up. After his association with the Jedi Master, Ferus decided to return to the Jedi Order and locate Jedi that survived Order 66, creating a safehouse for Jedi on an uncharted [[Jedi asteroid|asteroid]] in the middle of an atmospheric storm.<ref name="LastoftheJedi" />

During his search for Jedi refugees from the Empire, he was blackmailed into aiding Emperor Palpatine, but would act as a double-agent, seeking information and attempting to undermine the Empire from the inside, eventually confronting Darth Vader himself. His resistance movement spanned the galaxy from Bellassa, Acherin, Coruscant, Naboo, and Samaria to Alderaan as well as other planets. This lasted until the Empire thwarted his plans for early rebellion by destroying his secret asteroid base. He eventually accepted a mission from Obi-Wan to watch over Princess Leia Organa on Alderaan, where he would reside for many years. He would ultimately end up sacrificing himself to save Leia and her brother Luke from Vader, dying at the hands of the latter.<ref name="LastoftheJedi" />

===Starkiller's mission===
{{Quote|He was meant to root out the Rebels, not give them hope. His sacrifice will only inspire them&hellip;|[[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], reflecting on Galen Marek's death|<ref name="TFUII">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>}}
Since [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], Darth Vader had secretly been training an [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Galen Marek]], who had been captured as a child during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (c. 18 BBY)|suppression]] of [[Kento Marek|surviving Jedi]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Around [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], Marek was knighted as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and received the codename of "Starkiller", and was sent on numerous missions to eliminate surviving Jedi and disparate rebel groups. At a [[TIE Fighter Construction Facility]] over [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], Starkiller [[Battle of the TIE Fighter Construction Facility|destroyed]] the [[Kota's Militia|militia]] led by Jedi Master [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] and left their leader for dead. On [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]], he [[First mission to Raxus Prime|killed]] the insane [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] Jedi [[Kazdan Paratus]]. Finally, in a [[Mission to Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|mission]] on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], he killed Jedi Master [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]]. Starkiller expected to overthrow the Palpatine and rule the galaxy at Vader's side, but the Emperor had discovered his identity and ordered the Supreme Commander to kill him. Upon Starkiller's return, Vader [[Shiak|savagely injured]] him and cast his body into space.<ref name="Force Unleashed" />

Palpatine, however, came to think that Marek could be useful to him. Marek's body was recovered and sent for extensive medical treatment aboard the hospital ship ''[[Empirical]]''. Around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], Marek had recovered and was to be used to round up senators and leaders that were speaking against Empire in the Senate. Vader utilized Marek as an unwitting double agent, letting him believe that he was still working against the Emperor. Marek [[Skirmish on Cloud City|recovered]] the blinded and despondent Rahm Kota from [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] and convinced him to resume his fight against the Empire. He then [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Great Jedi Purge)|returned to Kashyyyk]], where Princess [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was being held hostage by Governor [[Ozzik Sturn]], and rescued Organa, killed Sturn, and disrupted the Empire's slaving operations against the Wookiees. Returning to Felucia, Marek [[Battle of Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|fought]] the Empire's attempted genocide of the [[Felucian/Legends|Felucians]] and rescued Bail Organa from [[Maris Brood]], Shaak Ti's grief-stricken apprentice. On Vader's advice, Marek subsequently [[Second mission to Raxus Prime|destroyed a shipyard]] over [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] as a symbolic blow against the Empire.
[[File:Battle_on_Death_Star_I.jpg|thumb|left|230px|Marek confronts Vader on the Death Star in order to rescue the Alliance leaders.]]
Marek then gathered Senators such as Bail Organa, Bail's daughter Leia, [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]], and Mon Mothma, as well as Jedi Master and [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] Rahm Kota, on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. In a swift series of [[Corellian System Meetings|Meetings]], they agreed to form the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]],<ref name="Force Unleashed" /> signing the [[Corellian Treaty]] with other rebel organizations and organizing into one Alliance.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref>

However, Vader, along with Imperial forces, raided the meeting, apprehended the rebels, and revealed to Marek that he had only been used as bait in rallying the Empire's enemies. The former Sith apprentice tracked the Supreme Commander and the captured Alliance leaders to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] in the [[Horuz system/Legends|Horuz system]]. There he [[Battle on Death Star I|dueled]] both Vader and Palpatine. Marek sacrificed himself, allowing the rebels to be rescued by his [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]]. Escaping to Kashyyyk, the senators, inspired by what he had done, vowed to continue with the Rebellion he had started.<ref name="Force Unleashed" />

===The Declaration of Rebellion===
{{Main|Declaration of Rebellion/Legends}}
{{Quote|We, the Rebel Alliance, do therefore in the name—and by the authority—of the free beings of the Galaxy, solemnly publish and declare our intentions: To fight and oppose you and your forces, by any and all means at our disposal; To refuse any Imperial law contrary to the rights of free beings; To bring about your destruction and the destruction of the Galactic Empire; To make forever free all beings in the galaxy. To these ends, we pledge our property, our honor, and our lives|The [[Declaration of Rebellion/Legends|Declaration of Rebellion]]|<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" />}}
Following the signing of the Corellian Treaty, the new Alliance's leaders made a public [[Declaration of Rebellion/Legends|Declaration of Rebellion]] in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. The Declaration was an overtly political one, intended to combat the Empire's propaganda that the Rebellion was nothing more than a new breed of Separatists. In it, the Rebels recognized the necessity of Galactic Government, but also declared that "when a Government displays a history of usurpation, abuse and moral atrocity, displaying a clear design to subjugate totally and absolutely beings born free under the auspices of nature, it is our right—our duty—to depose of that Government."<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" />

In addition to the symbolism of the Declaration, the Alliance took on a new emblem in the form of the [[Alliance Starbird|Marek family crest]], in memory of Galen Marek's sacrifice.<ref name="Force Unleashed" /> Thus began the war that would last two decades and cost billions of lives.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" /><ref name="NEC" />

==History==
===Early campaigns (2&ndash;1 BBY)===
====The first strikes (2&ndash;1 BBY)====
{{Quote|There may be a rebellion yet.|[[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]]|<ref name="Force Unleashed" />}}
The Declaration of Rebellion had mixed results: some [[Star system/Legends|systems]] enthusiastically declared their support for the Alliance. Branded the "[[Secession Worlds]]" by the Empire, they were swiftly crushed by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] in engagements like the [[Battle of Chabosh (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Chabosh]]. Additionally, while Mon Mothma, Garm Bel Iblis and Bail Organa were united in their determination to defeat the Empire, they were divided on how to achieve that goal: Mothma feared that the new Alliance was too weak to risk its forces in pursuing even symbolic strikes, while Bel Iblis feared that inaction would lead to frustrated Rebels going their own way.<ref name="Warfare" /> Early victories were gained in battles at [[Battle on Mantooine/Legends|Mantooine]] and the [[Battle in the Silken Asteroids|Silken Asteroids]], and the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|frigate]] [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']] was captured in a [[skirmish over Ylesia]].<ref name="Force Unleashed II novel" /> A decisive moment was the [[Liberation of Gial Ackbar|liberation]] of [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] from slavery in the [[Eriadu system/Legends|Eriadu system]]. The Mon Calamari had been kept as a valet by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] Wilhuff Tarkin and had been secretly feeding the Alliance Imperial Military secrets for months. Party to a great deal of information on Imperial Military doctrine, Ackbar would go on to be one of the Alliance's most successful [[Navy/Legends|naval]] commanders. However, at this early stage the Alliance's successes were few and far between.<ref name="Warfare" />

[[1 BBY/Legends|One year]] after the Declaration of Rebellion, [[General/Legends|General]] Rahm Kota, tired of inaction, formed [[Kota's squad|his own commando squad]], believing that tactical strikes by small forces against critical targets could effectively disrupt Imperial forces throughout an entire region. Kota successfully struck at Imperial targets on several worlds, including [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]], [[Selonia/Legends|Selonia]], and [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], against the orders of [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]], with the assistance of Captain [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]] aboard the ''Salvation''. In a [[Raid on Cato Neimoidia|raid]] at [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], however, Kota was caught in an ambush and thought dead by the Alliance, though was in fact captured and forced into [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] combat by the Imperial administrator, [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Merillion Tarko]].<ref name="Force Unleashed II novel" />

Suspended from active duty over Cato Neimoidia, Juno Eclipse continued to support Kota's philosophy and enlisted the aid of Gial Ackbar for a [[Heurkea operation|mission to Dac]], which was still under Imperial occupation. Eclipse believed that a display of resistance would galvanize the [[Mon Calamari Resistance|Dac rebels]] and bring them and the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] of the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]] into the Alliance fold. The successful mission humiliated [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] Tarkin, who had believed that he could use the opportunity to recapture Ackbar and split the Mon Calamari Resistance, brought Dac closer to the Alliance, and united both the Mon Calamari and the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] in resisting the Empire, laying the groundwork for their eventual [[Calamarian Revolt|successful revolt]].<ref name="Force Unleashed II novel" /><ref name="Warfare" />

[[File:Battle_of_Kamino_TFU2.png|thumb|right|275px|The Alliance and Empire fight over [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].]]
Unbeknownst to the Alliance, Darth Vader had spent the past six months attempting to [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] Galen Marek, ultimately producing and [[Sith training|training]] a stable clone known as [[Subject 1138|Starkiller]], whom he planned to send to kill Kota. However, after Starkiller had [[Memory flash|visions]] of Juno Eclipse, whom Galen Marek had come to [[love]], Vader dismissed him as an [[aberrant clone]] and attempted to kill him. Starkiller [[Escape from Kamino (1 BBY)|escaped]] from the [[Timira City Cloning Facility|cloning facility]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] and resolved to join the Alliance and find Eclipse. [[Rescue of Rahm Kota|Rescuing Rahm Kota]] from [[Tarko-se/Legends|Tarko-se]] on Cato Neimoidia, the two attempted to rejoin the [[Unidentified Alliance fleet|Rebel fleet]] in the [[Itani Nebula/Legends|Itani Nebula]], but the fleet was [[Battle near the Itani Nebula|engaged]] by Imperial forces led by the bounty hunter Boba Fett, whom Vader had contracted to capture Eclipse, knowing Starkiller would seek to rescue her.<ref name="TFUII" />

Abducting Eclipse and bringing her to Kamino, Starkiller and the Alliance pursued and [[Assault on Kamino|battled]] the Empire over the ocean planet, taking heavy casualties. The battle culminated with the ''Salvation'' being used as a [[ramship]] to take down the shield around [[Timira City]], allowing Starkiller and General Kota's troops to enter the city, rescue Captain Eclipse and even capture [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Vader.<ref name="TFUII" />

Though the Dark Lord of the Sith would ultimately escape, Alliance morale soared in the aftermath of the victory on Kamino. Additionally, Mon Mothma came to accept the need for greater action against the Empire, and seriously considered adopting Eclipse and Kota's tactics.<ref name="Force Unleashed II novel" />

====Operation Domino (1 BBY)====
{{Main|Operation Domino}}
Later in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the Alliance crafted its first war plan, [[Operation Domino]]. This envisioned the Rebellion's newly organized [[Sector Force/Legends|Sector Forces]] defeating Imperial garrisons in showpiece ground battles across the galaxy, then digging in behind their [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shields]]. It was expected that such examples would inspire a galaxywide revolution against the Empire.<ref name="Warfare" />

In the event, Operation Domino met with disaster: the vast majority of the Sector Forces were ill-equipped or ill-trained, or lacked essential elements like air support. Virtually every uprising was swiftly put down by the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].<ref name="Warfare" /> At [[Dalron Five]], Imperial forces [[Siege of Dalron Five|besieged the planet]] and broke through to the surface using siege techniques developed by [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]], resulting in heavy civilian casualties. The operation prompted Dodonna to defect to the Alliance.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 1">''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]''</ref> The Alliance was vastly outmanned and outgunned by the well-organized and powerful Imperial Military. Sporting a vast fleet supplied by such companies as [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] and an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Army]] and [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] that numbered in the billions, the Empire secured a stranglehold on the galaxy that was impossible to challenge conventionally.<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook" />

However, Operation Domino did contain a few bright spots that in the long term would be enormously decisive: the [[Calamarian Revolt|liberation of]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] was one of the few successes of the campaign, and the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]] became a potent Rebel redoubt for nearly the entirety of the war. Calamari [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|warships]] that had escaped the [[Subjugation of Mon Calamari|Imperial occupation]], led by the [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']], were added to the Alliance arsenal. The [[Mon Calamari Council]] nominally declared neutrality and heavily [[Space mine/Legends|mined]] the routes leading into their sector, thus ensuring that any campaign to reclaim the region would be incredibly costly for the Empire. The Empire was hesitant to engage in such a campaign, fearing that anything other than a quick victory would embolden other rebellious systems.<ref name="Warfare" /> [[Ambush at Mon Calamari|Early efforts]] by the Empire to reclaim Dac ultimately [[Rescue at Mon Calamari|developed into fiascos]].<ref name="X-wing" /> The Mon Calamari became an essential source of ships and supplies for the Rebellion, formally declaring for the Alliance in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="Warfare" />

This helped the Alliance's chances of survival, but it was still too small to directly confront the might of the Imperial Navy. The Rebels' bravery also inspired a surge of sympathy for them across the galaxy, including within the ranks of the Imperial Military. Numerous officers, including General Jan Dodonna, Admiral [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]], and General [[Kryll]], had seen their faith in the Empire sorely tested by its increasingly brutal and arbitrary conduct, and defected to the Alliance.<ref name="Warfare" />

====The Alliance strategy====
[[File:Galactic_Civil_War.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Major actions in the Galactic Civil War prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]]]
The failure of Operation Domino convinced Mon Mothma that the Alliance could not win the Civil War if it fought conventionally. This prompted a divide between Mothma and her officers in Alliance High Command: as former Republic officers or Imperial defectors, they saw the struggle in terms of territory, and envisioned an advance from the fortified redoubt of Mon Calamari to seize the restless [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]], and from there move down the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] to capture restive worlds like [[Roche asteroid field|Roche]], [[Contruum/Legends|Contruum]] and Kashyyyk.<ref name="Warfare" /> Mon Mothma saw this as inevitably leading to a repeat of the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], which would end with the Alliance's territories being ground down by the Empire's superior industrial base.<ref name="Atlas1">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Mothma thus favored a [[stateless strategy]]: the Alliance was relegated to hit-and-run tactics, designed to harass Imperial shipping and operations.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" />

The [[Alliance Army/Legends|Alliance Army]] was reorganized around the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|SpecForces]]: optimized for commando warfare and numbering barely one hundred thousand beings, the SpecForces became a flexible backbone for the entire Rebellion. Barracks regiments acted as specialist support echelons for other branches of the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]], while temporary task forces were detached for missions. Often, both regiments and task forces were used to buttress the weaknesses of the Alliance's local [[Sector Force/Legends|Sector Forces]].<ref name="Warfare" />

As ground tactics shifted, [[Starfighter Command (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Starfighter Command]] came to the fore, championed by General Jan Dodonna of [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]]. A proponent of the largely unfashionable view that the [[Starfighter Corps/Legends|starfighter corps]] should be a separate branch of the military, Dodonna believed that [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]-capable [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] could [[Space denial|undermine]] the Empire's control of space. He demonstrated this with raids conducted by [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] that destroyed [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] fleets at [[Battle of Denab|Denab]], [[Battle of Vnas|Vnas]] and [[Battle of Tarawa|Tarawa]]. Thereafter, finding suitable targets for the [[Alliance Starfighter Corps/Legends|Alliance Starfighter Corps]] became the priority for [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]], while Dodonna geared [[Ordnance and Supply/Legends|Ordnance and Supply]] and the [[Support Services/Legends|Support Services]] to providing the materiel and men for raiding.<ref name="Warfare" />

As the Rebellion grew, starfighters became its primary combat force, though the majority of fighter squadrons were attached to Sector Forces, or to the increasingly powerful [[Rebel Fleet Command/Legends|Fleet Command]]. In the Alliance's early years, the brunt of [[Space warfare/Legends|space combat]] was borne by local [[Sector Force/Legends|Sector Forces]], particularly Garm Bel Iblis' [[Corellian Resistance/Legends|Corellian Resistance]]. Fleet Command was created to oversee the ragtag collection of [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] that had escaped their home sectors, most notably the Alliance flagship [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']], which had escaped the occupation of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. The success of their starfighter tactics led many Rebel commanders to distrust cruiser warfare, but Mothma insisted on building up a [[Line of battle|battle line]], led by the old CIS warships ''[[Rebel One]]'' and ''[[Fortressa]]'' as well as her own flagship ''[[New Hope]]''. The new [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] was under Dodonna's overall command, with its senior [[Admiral/Legends|admirals]] including Gial Ackbar of Dac.<ref name="Warfare" /> The Fleet would roam the galaxy, challenging Imperial authority merely by existing, and waiting for the chance of a decisive battle with the Galactic Empire.<ref name="Atlas1" />

Finally, diplomatic efforts were made by such Rebel leaders as Leia Organa to win the hearts and minds of species across the galaxy to add to the Rebel cause. Under the guise of mercy missions delivering aid to planets in need, Leia conducted her missions under secrecy aboard the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], her membership of the Imperial Senate giving her diplomatic immunity. Leia's missions in support of rebel groups took her to [[Kostra]], [[Belassar system/Legends|Belassar]], and [[Gendrah-Narvin system/Legends|Gendrah-Narvin]]. She secretly supported an [[Solaest Uprising|uprising]] on [[Solaest]], and helped General [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] coordinate an [[Battle of Nentan|evacuation]] of Rebel assets at [[Nentan]].<ref name="Atlas" />

With the war still in its infancy, the Alliance and Empire both fought each other across an ever-widening playing field. The Alliance could not hope to make a direct stand against the Empire and thus spread out across the galaxy, planting cells and sowing dissent amongst population centers. The Empire, with its vast resources, fought to keep up and hunt the Alliance down. Fighting erupted on [[Humiliation of Barkhesh|Barkhesh]], [[Fighting on Immalia|Immalia]], [[Debacle on Ord Torrenze|Ord Torrenze]], and even at [[Pacification of Salline|Salline]] on Mon Mothma's homeworld of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]].<ref name="Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref> Alliance outposts, such as one on Kashyyyk, were [[Assault on Kashyyyk|located and destroyed]].<ref name="Empire at War">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref>

As the Rebellion grew, so too did the ferocity with which it was hunted. Entire sectors were set upon by Imperial forces, whenever they were identified as hotbeds for Rebel activity. At [[Bompreil]], efforts to [[Battle of Bompreil|root out]] a Rebel cell resulted in heavy civilian casualties.<ref name="Allegiance novel">[[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']]</ref> The [[Sullust/Legends|Sullustan]] moon of [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]] was [[Subjugation of Sulon|violently subjugated]] by [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]] after the inhabitants asserted independence from the corporate control of the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]], killing all the Rebels and desecrating their bodies. Shortly afterwards, a Rebel communications center on the asteroid [[AX-456]] was [[Battle of AX-456|destroyed]] by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] led by [[Cadet Leader]] [[Kyle Katarn]], who ultimately defected to the Rebel Alliance after he learned that [[Morgan Katarn|his father]] had been killed on Sulon.<ref name="Soldier for the Empire">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref> The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowports]] of [[Datar/Legends|Datar]] and [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] were attacked in [[Attack at Datar|separate]] [[Battle of Nar Shaddaa (Galactic Civil War)|battles]] in an effort to destroy the Rebels' smuggling-based supply network.<ref name="MosEisley">''[[Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina]]''</ref>

====The X-wing and Turkana (1 BBY)====
{{Main|Fresian campaign|Battle of Turkana|Operation Strike Fear}}
In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], a pivotal moment in the war occurred when the Empire nationalized the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]. This caused a stir throughout the corporation that led designers and staff to offer their help to the Alliance. Through this, the Alliance learned of the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] and a holding facility on [[Fresia/Legends|Fresia]] where four prototypes of the starfighter were held. Seeking to replace the aging [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]], Alliance Command thus launched the [[Fresian campaign]], aimed at stealing the X-wing prototypes in hopes of eventually mass-producing the starfighter for use against the Empire. Led by [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]], a diversionary [[Space Battle at Kuat|assault]] was made on [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], and a [[Battle on Wayland|second]] on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]], to draw the Imperial forces away from Fresia. The Alliance then landed on Fresia and in the [[Battle of Fresia|battle]] that followed captured the prototypes. The Alliance subsequently [[Space Battle in the Kessel Asteroid Field|rescued]] the Incom design team from Imperial captivity in the [[Kessel system/Legends|Kessel system]].<ref name="Empire at War" />

[[File:Battle_of_Turkana.png|thumb|right|210px|The [[Battle of Turkana/Legends|Battle of Turkana]]]]
With the X-wing in possession, an Alliance task force led by Gial Ackbar defeated Imperial units at the [[Battle of Turkana/Legends|Battle of Turkana]]; surprised by the Alliance's "secret weapon," the Imperial forces led by [[Xamuel Lennox]] and [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]] were destroyed. The Empire retaliated with [[Operation Strike Fear]], an offensive intended to pacify Rebel systems in the restless Tion Cluster. The Alliance discovered the operation in [[Battle in the Dellalt system|two]] [[Mission in the Dellalt system|reconnaissance missions]] in the [[Dellalt system/Legends|Dellalt system]] led by [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]], forcing them to [[Battle of Brigia (Galactic Civil War)|evacuate]] their [[Brigia Rebel base|base]] on [[Brigia/Legends|Brigia]]. The Alliance successfully delayed the operation with the [[Raid on the Juno convoy|capture of an Imperial convoy]], but the Imperials recovered with victories at [[Raid in the Rudrig system|Rudrig]] and [[Battle of Orion IV|Orion IV]].<ref name="X-wing" /> Elsewhere, Rebel Y-wings broke the Imperial [[Siege of Ank Ki'Shor|siege]] of [[Ank Ki'Shor]], saving its population from an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]].<ref name="Xim Week">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref>

Imperial forces were drawn away from the Tion Cluster after the [[Sullustan Resistance]] overthrew the SoroSuub-dominated corporate government of Sullust, which was backed by the Empire. In response, Imperial reinforcements in the [[Sullust system]] captured numerous [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] technicians, who were subsequently [[Rescue of Sullustan Tech Staff|rescued]] by Alliance forces, paving the way for [[Diplomatic Summit at Sullust|diplomatic negotiations]] between Sullust and the Alliance. With the Sullustans in the Alliance's fold, together with information supplied by Commander [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]], a disaffected Imperial officer who was considering defection, the Alliance [[Destruction of the Invincible|destroyed]] the Star Destroyer [[Invincible (Strike Fear)|''Invincible'']], the flagship of the operation.<ref name="X-wing" />

In the aftermath of Turkana, Ackbar was invited back to the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]] to lead the rebuilt [[Calamari Defense Force]]. Ackbar resigned from the Alliance Fleet, but continued to supervise the [[Shantipole Project]]&mdash;the Alliance's effort to create the [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]]&mdash;from afar, and worked to secure Dac's commitment to the Rebel cause. With the rescue of the Incom design team, Alliance began mass production of the X-wing starfighter, sharing the plans with sympathetic governments and species, including the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] and the Mon Calamari, assembling the craft in secret hangars and clandestine dry docks across the galaxy. The superlative fighter proved its worth in the subsequent [[Fei Hu campaign]] of [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], where the [[Lightspeed Panthers]] fighter wing destroyed 286 TIE Fighters in nine months with the loss of only four T-65s. The humiliating destruction of three Imperial capital ships by the unsupported X-wings of [[Renegade Flight]] at the [[Battle of Ton-Falk]] prompted the Empire to develop the [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|''Ton Falk''-class escort carrier]]. While later campaigns were less one-sided, with the Imperial introduction of the ''Ton Falk''-class, the [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]] and the [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigate]], the Galactic Empire was never seriously able to challenge Rebel dominance in the air.<ref name="Warfare" />

===The ultimate power in the universe (1&ndash;0 BBY)===
====The Death Star and the Tarkin Doctrine====
[[File:DS1_under_construction.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] under construction]]
{{Quote|This station is now the ultimate power in the universe! I suggest we use it.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]]|<ref name="Episode IV" />}}
{{Main|Death Star/Legends|Tarkin Doctrine/Legends}}
The [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star project]] and other Imperial [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]] were the Empire's attempts to correct the Rebels' [[stateless strategy]]. Even with the immense size of the Imperial Navy, the galaxy was still far too large to be effectively policed, and the Rebel Alliance undermined the Empire through [[Hit-and-hype raiding|hit-and-run strikes]] launched from hidden bases.<ref name="Atlas" /> The Empire's response was a policy of reprisal, a system of state terror that was institutionalized in the Tarkin Doctrine.<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook" /> However, the policy of overwhelming force in an effort to deny the Rebels haven did more to foment resistance than eliminate it.<ref name="Atlas" />

The creation of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] was intended to reverse such a state of affairs by introducing the possibility of a reprisal so terrifying&mdash;namely, the destruction of entire planets&mdash;that no world would risk aiding the Rebellion. It came about in a roundabout way, first being suggested as the [[Expeditionary Battle Planetoid]] by then-[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Wilhuff Tarkin to Supreme Chancellor Palpatine in [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]] as a means of correcting lawlessness on the Outer Rim. As his alter ego Darth Sidious, Palpatine ordered [[Geonosian Industries/Legends|Geonosian Industries]] and [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] to begin conceptualizing the "Ultimate Weapon." When [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] fell to the Republic in the first battle of the Clone Wars, [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] delivered the [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]] to Sidious on Coruscant. Construction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] began over occupied Geonosis in the weeks after the Clone Wars ended. Tarkin's involvement in the development of the Death Star came full circle in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], when he presented his fully formed Tarkin Doctrine to Emperor Palpatine. Impressed, Palpatine promoted Tarkin to the new rank of Grand Moff and placed in command of the Death Star project.<ref name="Atlas" />

Construction of the Death Star was slow: the necessity of keeping such a project a secret meant that it was beset by supply problems, and uprisings by slave laborers and sabotage meant that the construction site had to be moved multiple times. The battlestation took nearly nineteen years to complete, but when it was finally operational in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] it was the largest starship ever built: 120 kilometers in diameter, it boasted a [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] main weapon that could destroy an entire planet, and was invulnerable to even the largest fleet attacks.<ref name="Warfare" />

However, the Death Star, and the strategy of terror it implied, caused strong friction within the Imperial Military's hierarchy. The "[[Generationals]]" of the Imperial Navy—those whose families had done military service for centuries—saw the fleet as a tool for establishing stability and order, and through it bring peace. They were horrified by the Tarkin Doctrine's principle of "rule through fear of force." The Death Star project even led Moff [[Kalast]] to defect to the Rebellion. In contrast, up-and-coming officers like Tarkin and Admiral [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]] despised the Generationals for their commitment to traditional strategies and believed in the power of example to cow the rest of the galaxy into submission.<ref name="Atlas" /> Motti's arguments won Tarkin's ear, and he was appointed commander of Naval Operations aboard the Death Star.<ref name="Author's Cut 11">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-11-serving-the-empire|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 11: Serving the Empire}}</ref>

The concerns of the Navy were, ironically, best articulated by [[High General]] [[Cassio Tagge/Legends|Cassio Tagge]] of the Imperial Army, and commander of [[Army Operations]] aboard the Death Star. Tagge believed that the traditional model of the Navy commanding space to protect the Army in ground assaults was a proven, efficient and flexible strategy. He also considered the Alliance far more dangerous than the Empire realized, and that the Death Star was drawing away resources from more valuable endeavors like the stalled [[Sarlacc Project]], the development of a [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|new class]] of gargantuan [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnoughts]]. Motti's response was that the mere existence of the Death Star left the Army free to act, and that if it met serious resistance on the ground, the Army could withdraw and the Death Star destroy the planet. Tagge's arguments that this was an inflexible strategy and Motti's flippant attitude, mockingly referring to the Navy as "your starfleet" to bait the General, habitually complicated operations on the Death Star.<ref name="Atlas" />

====Kalast's insurrection (1 BBY)====
The Death Star project led the Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kalast]] to contemplate defection to the Rebel Alliance, slipping information on the Death Star to the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] and the Alliance at large from his Star Destroyer. Kalast hid on [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]], and Vader was personally assigned the task of hunting down and bringing the treacherous Moff to Imperial justice. After [[Assault on Thyferra|escaping arrest]] at Thyferra, Kalast began fomenting uprisings against the Empire, first with an [[Invasion of Fondor|insurrection]] on [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]], and then a [[Battle at Jabiim|battle]] on [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]].<ref name="Empire at War" />

With information obtained from Jabiim, Vader learned that Kalast had fled to his base on [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri]]. Two battles were fought over Atzerri, [[Battle at Atzerri|the first]] between the Empire, Alliance, and a pirate who offered to sell information on the Rebellion to the Empire, and [[Arrest over Atzerri|the second]] in an attempt by Vader to arrest Kalast. However, the elusive Moff escaped. Enraged at yet another failure, the Supreme Commander established a task force complete with a newly minted [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]] to scour the galaxy and find the traitor. In an effort to protect Kalast, the Alliance Fleet engaged the Empire in a string of battles at [[Shola/Legends|Shola]], [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], and [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. After perhaps months of actively pursuing the traitor, Vader finally pinned Kalast down and [[Capture of Kalast|captured him]]. Kalast was brought before Palpatine and executed after he was forced to divulge his dealings with the Bothans, which led to the [[Mission to Bothawui|deaths of many Bothans]] in a punitive mission to [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]].<ref name="Empire at War" />

====Operation Skyhook (1&ndash;0 BBY)====
{{Quote|Several transmissions were beamed to this ship by Rebel spies. I want to know what happened to the plans they sent you.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="Episode IV" />}}
{{Main|Operation Skyhook|Death Star plans/Legends}}
[[File:Devastatortantiveiv.png|thumb|right|250px|The [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] chases down the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']].]]
A project as massive as the Death Star could not be kept entirely secret. Through a combination of rumors, raids and an efficient and widespread intelligence network of Bothan spies, the Alliance learned of the construction of the Death Star.<ref name="Episode IV" /> The Alliance thus launched [[Operation Skyhook]], one of the widest-ranging operations in its history, aimed at acquiring a complete set of plans for the Death Star so that they might locate and exploit a weakness. All resources were poured into the effort; if such a weapon was unleashed upon the galaxy, it would spell certain doom for the Alliance.<ref name="NEC" />

Construction of the Death Star had thus far taken many years; supervised by Tarkin, the project had hit many standstills, some of which included a shortage of labor, which was alleviated through the [[Subjugation of Geonosis]] and the enslavement of the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]].<ref name="Empire at War" /> Soon after, a [[Death Star Uprising|riot]] erupted aboard the Death Star, led by Rebel prisoners. They managed to steal a technical readout of the battle station; while many of the rioters were killed, some escaped with the plans to the [[Polis Massa Base|Rebel base]] on [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]], where they were transferred to Alliance Command amid a [[Raid on Polis Massa|raid on the base]] by the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]].<ref name="Battlefront II">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref> The Alliance received fresh confirmation of the progress of the Death Star project from an informant recovered by Princess Leia Organa under the guise of a mercy mission during the [[Subjugation of Ralltiir]], which was later corroborated by the Imperial officer [[Commodore/Legends|Commodore]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Tion (Lord)/Legends|Tion]].<ref name="NEC" />

The Polis Massa plans, combined with another set [[Mission to Danuta|acquired]] by Kyle Katarn at [[Danuta]],<ref name="Dark Forces">''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]''</ref> and another acquired during the [[Battle of Toprawa]], allowed the Alliance to conceive a full technical readout of the Death Star that could be analyzed for weaknesses. The complete plans, however, were trapped on [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]] by Imperial reinforcements led by Lord Vader. Under the guise of a mercy mission, Princess Leia arrived in the [[Toprawa system/Legends|Toprawa system]], and the plans were beamed to the ''Tantive IV''.<ref name="Episode IV" /> The Signal branch of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence's]] [[Analysis Bureau (Imperial Intelligence)|Analysis Bureau]], however, tracked the transmission from Toprawa to Leia Organa's ship and Darth Vader's Star Destroyer, the [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']], began an immediate pursuit.<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook" />

Hoping to enlist the help of Obi-Wan Kenobi, Leia Organa rushed towards Tatooine with the plans in hand; however, Vader caught up and captured the ''Tantive IV'' in a [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|short space battle]]. As Vader's forces entered her ship, Leia Organa made a desperate gamble and hid the plans of the Death Star in the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. R2-D2, along with [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] on the ship, used an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] to travel to Tatooine, where they were purchased from the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] scavengers who found them by Owen Lars, uncle of Luke Skywalker.<ref name="Episode IV" /> Stormtrooper units, including the 501st Legion and the [[Desert Sands]], were deployed to Tatooine to find the missing [[Droid/Legends|droids]], while Rebel forces in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]] began a [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|desperate series of skirmishes]] in an effort to waylay the Imperial search.<ref name="Battlefront">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]''</ref>

Skywalker soon discovered a portion of the message in R2-D2 and became interested. However, R2-D2, operating under programming included with the plans, escaped and tried to find Obi-Wan Kenobi. Skywalker, who encountered Kenobi in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]], tracked him down. R2-D2 then played back for them Leia Organa's desperate plea for help. The two discovered that Imperial stormtroopers had attacked the Jawas who had sold them the two droids in a search for the plans. Luke returned to his home to find his aunt and uncle slaughtered at Imperial hands. He then accompanied Kenobi to [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], where, after evading Imperial troops, the two negotiated with smuggler [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his first mate, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], to take them and the plans to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="Episode IV" />

====The destruction of Alderaan (0 BBY)====
{{Quote|I grow tired of asking, so it will be the last time. Where is rebel base?|Wilhuff Tarkin to Leia Organa|<ref name="Episode IV" />}}
{{Main|Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Rescue of Princess Leia/Legends}}
[[File:DestructionOfAlderaan-ANH.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] is [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] by the Death Star's superlaser.]]
In the meantime, Emperor Palpatine used the ongoing war as a pretext for [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|dissolving the Imperial Senate]].<ref name="Episode IV" /><ref name="Imperial Sourcebook" /> With the Death Star shortly to become operational, Palpatine felt that he no longer had any need of the last remnants of the Republic's bureaucracy to control the Outer Rim. The fear engendered by the battle station would be the principal source of Imperial control in the Outer Rim.<ref name="Episode IV" />

Princess Organa was transferred to the Death Star by Lord Vader and interrogated for the location of the Alliance's hidden base. Leia refused to yield to [[Torture/Legends|torture]], but was forced into a difficult position when Governor Tarkin threatened to destroy Alderaan, her homeworld, if she did not reveal the base's location. Fearing the loss of Alderaan, but understanding she could not betray her allies on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], Leia lied to Tarkin and Vader, declaring that the base was on distant Dantooine, isolated from the galaxy at large. Tarkin, confident in his victory, continued with the operation to destroy Alderaan regardless, stating that Dantooine was "too remote for an effective demonstration." Thus, [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan was destroyed]] by a single blast from the Death Star, an act of [[mundicide]] that killed billions of sentients, including Bail Organa, and sealed the fate of the Empire.<ref name="Episode IV" />

The Grand Moff of the [[Oversector Outer]] still had matters with the Rebel base; a scout team was sent to Dantooine to ascertain whether a base was indeed there. Meanwhile, the ''Millennium Falcon'' arrived in-system, carrying Luke Skywalker, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and R2-D2, who still had the Death Star's technical readouts. Trapped aboard the Death Star due to the massive array of [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]], Luke sought to [[Rescue of Princess Leia/Legends|rescue Leia]] while Obi-Wan went alone to disable the tractor beam generator and confront Darth Vader.<ref name="Episode IV" />

Tarkin ordered Leia's execution when he learned of her deceit; however, before the order could be carried out, Luke rescued her. A daring escape through the Death Star's corridors commenced. As they made it to the hangar to escape aboard the ''Falcon'', a concerned Luke watched as Obi-Wan Kenobi faced off against his former apprentice, Darth Vader. With a knowing smile, Obi-Wan purposefully let down his guard and allowed himself to be cut down by Vader's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], immediately becoming one with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] as his physical form disappeared.<ref name="Episode IV" />

====The Battle of Yavin (0 BBY)====
{{Dialogue|Princess Leia|Some day you'll learn that it's people and not things that decide history.|Han Solo|Better teach that to the Empire, first.|Luke Skywalker|That's the whole idea, Han.|attr=Conversation before the Battle of Yavin|src=<ref name="SW Radio">[[Star Wars (radio)|''Star Wars'' radio drama]]</ref>}}
{{Main|Battle of Yavin/Legends}}
[[File:Probe_Their_Defense_TCG_by_Ludvigsen.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The attack on the Death Star]]
The ''Millennium Falcon'' escaped soon after, pursued by several [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] but ultimately allowed to escape by Tarkin, as he hoped that the ''Falcon'' would lead straight to the Rebels' hidden base. His plan proved effective; with a homing beacon aboard the ship, the Empire learned that the Rebels were hiding on Yavin 4. After [[Raid on Yavin 4|sending]] a platoon of stormtroopers to the moon to confirm Rebel activity,<ref name="Battlefront" /> course was set to the Yavin system to destroy the Alliance.<ref name="Episode IV" />

In the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]], the technical readouts were analyzed and an attack plan was conceived by Jan Dodonna. With the Death Star looming overhead and entering range to unleash its superlaser, Rebel ships took off in a desperate attempt to destroy the behemoth battle station. The plan called for cutting across the Death Star's equatorial trench and following it down to a small thermal exhaust port, where a single [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] would be able to reach the Death Star's main reactor and set off a chain reaction, should it hit. In an intense [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|battle]], Rebel pilots attempted to stave off Imperial starfighters while attack runs were made against the exhaust port. Tarkin, underestimating the Alliance's chances, refused to send out more than a squadron of starfighters to deal with the Rebel problem; he ignored Chief [[Moradmin Bast/Legends|Moradmin Bast's]] warnings of a threat to the exhaust port and continued with his descent upon Yavin IV.<ref name="Episode IV" />

As Darth Vader and other Imperial pilots destroyed Rebel pilots one by one, Luke Skywalker, [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]], and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] made one last run against the trench. Vader killed Biggs and forced Wedge to retreat, and was moments away from shooting down his son, Luke, before Han Solo entered the fight with the ''Millennium Falcon''. Solo drove Vader out of the battle, giving Luke one shot at the thermal port. The attack succeeded, and moments later the Death Star exploded, taking with it millions of Imperial lives. Yavin 4, and the Alliance, was saved.<ref name="Episode IV" />

This pivotal moment secured Luke Skywalker's journey towards being a Jedi Knight, and marked a major turning point in the galactic war against the Empire. From then on, the Empire no longer took the Rebellion for granted; Palpatine issued directives to drastically increase the size of the military, expanding the armed forces to unprecedented levels to counter the threat of the Alliance and growing dissent across the galaxy.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" /><ref name="Imperial Sourcebook" />

===After Yavin (0&ndash;2 ABY)===
====The Blockade of Yavin (0 ABY)====
{{Main|Yavin blockade|Evacuation of Yavin}}
[[File:GordianReach.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] was the site of a tense few months of operations as the Rebels defied the [[Yavin blockade]].]]
{{Quote|By the time we landed on Yavin, whatever shock we'd felt at the destruction of the Death Star had been replaced by anger. For months we'd treated the Rebellion like a disobedient child, only to be repaid for our tolerance with treachery on an unimaginable scale. Frankly, I don't remember much of the fighting. I guess we won.|Entry from the [[501st Journal]]|<ref name="Battlefront II" />}}
The Battle of Yavin gave the Rebel Alliance credibility as a legitimate military threat to the Empire. With the Death Star's loss over Yavin, the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Destruction of Alderaan]] and the murder of billions was no longer an object lesson, but a rallying cry for the resistance. The Empire increasingly relied on acts of terror to stamp out dissent, for example, the release of the [[Candorian plague/Legends|Candorian plague]] on [[Dentaal/Legends|Dentaal]].<ref name="Atlas1" /> In the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]], [[Clariv]] was subjugated for Rebel sympathies.<ref name="Xim Week" />

The Rebel commanders knew celebrations would be short-lived. Because of the Death Star's destruction, the Empire would focus all of its military might into destroying the Rebels.<ref name="NEC" /> Preparations were made for a full-scale evacuation of Massassi Station and relocation to another secure hideout. The Empire expected the Rebels to flee Yavin immediately, but instead much of the base remained intact. Jan Dodonna supervised evacuation efforts, but while some heavy equipment and critical supplies were removed, he convinced Mon Mothma that most personnel and equipment could be hastily evacuated at short notice. He saw making a stand on Yavin 4 as a powerful statement of defiance and a recruiting tool.<ref name="Warfare" />

In turn, the Empire countered with a [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] effort of its own: just prior to Yavin, the planet [[Ord Biniir/Legends|Ord Biniir]] had been [[First Battle of Ord Biniir|taken]] by a force of Rebel Y-wings. The [[2/181st|second squadron]] of the [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Wing]], led by Captain [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]], was sent to retake the planet. Under Fel's expert leadership, the [[Second Battle of Ord Biniir]] was an utter rout. But for the fact it had happened on the same day as the Battle of Yavin, Ord Biniir would have been a terrible Rebel defeat. However, the Empire heavily publicized the victory to distract from Yavin, and Fel was publicly promoted to [[Major/Legends|Major]] and given ''de facto'' command of his unit, which was rebuilt as an elite group. The 181st Imperial Fighter Group would become one of the most celebrated units of the Galactic Empire's [[Starfighter Corps (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Starfighter Corps]], and one of the most feared by the Alliance.<ref name="Warfare" />

The Imperial Navy established a [[Yavin blockade|loose blockade]] around the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]], but it was complicated by a lack of ships. The starfleet was spread thin searching for the roving Alliance Fleet, and to commit too many ships to Yavin would allow the Rebels to make major strikes elsewhere and make the Empire look impotent. Alternatively, if too few were committed, Mon Mothma and Admiral Ackbar might arrive in strength to break the blockade and win a second battle of Yavin. Darth Vader, meanwhile, was committed to leading the attack on Yavin personally from the bridge of his nearly complete [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], a colossal warship designed to be so powerful that its mere existence would pacify multiple sectors.<ref name="Warfare" /> As the ''Executor'' was completed, the blockade would fix the Rebels in place.<ref name="Atlas1" />

However, the Yavin blockade was riven by infighting between [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Orman Tagge/Legends|Orman Tagge]] and Moff [[Nox Vellam]] of the [[Bright Jewel Oversector/Legends|Bright Jewel Oversector]]. Consequently, during the siege, Luke Skywalker and other Rebel pilots slipped through the blockade to perform covert missions and search for a suitable planet to relocate from Yavin. One such [[Mission to Fondor (Galactic Civil War)|mission]] took Luke to Fondor, where he saw the final stages of the ''Executor''{{'s}} construction before its departure to Yavin. A subsequent [[Battle at the Iron Tower|mission]] took Luke to [[Aridus/Legends|Aridus]], where he assisted the [[Chubbit resistance]] in destroying an Imperial [[signal amplifier]] known as the [[Iron Tower]]. On his return from this mission, Luke stumbled upon the ice world of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] after an accident with a comet, which he reported back to Alliance Command as the perfect spot to relocate after Yavin was evacuated.<ref name="Classic">"[[Darth Vader Strikes]]"</ref>

With the ''Executor''{{'s}} launch, the Alliance launched a formal [[evacuation of Yavin]]. The 501st Legion descended upon the moon with elements of the Imperial Army and besieged the Alliance temple and headquarters; during a series of skirmishes that lasted some time, many Alliance commanders and personnel were killed, and Dodonna was captured and presumed killed by the surviving Alliance personnel who escaped through the Imperial blockade.<ref name="NEC" /><ref name="Battlefront II" />

To aid evacuation efforts, Admiral Ackbar led the [[Calamari Defense Force|Mon Calamari fleet]] in a diversionary assault on the nearby planets [[Kli'aar]], [[Pinoora]], and the [[Vallusk Cluster/Legends|Vallusk Cluster]]; the assault was a success, with a significant portion of the Imperial fleet diverting its resources to deal with Ackbar.<ref name="Classic" /> However, the assault showed that Mon Mothma and other Alliance commanders needed a stronger, unified fleet. Ackbar was promoted to Supreme Commander of the Rebel Fleet and military, and efforts were made to increase the size of the standard military. 

Meanwhile, the Massassi leadership, prepared to escape down a series of secret routes to the Hydian Way via the uninhabited [[Tertiary Feswe system/Legends|Tertiary Feswe system]]. However, the Empire cut off the Tertiary Feswe and [[Feswe Minor system/Legends|Feswe Minor]] routes, forcing the Rebels to make a risky escape around the unstable star [[Feswe Prime]], assisted by Luke Skywalker's use of the Force. Vader moved the ''Executor'' to intercept, but was thwarted when the over-eager Admiral [[Amise Griff]] rushed to engage, causing three of his Star Destroyers to come out of hyperspace right on top of the ''Executor'' and slam into its shields. In the confusion, the Alliance escaped.<ref name="Atlas1" />

[[File:Dark_Time.png|thumb|right|220px|Massassi Station under the occupation of the Empire]]

====Alliance on the Run (0&ndash;1 ABY)====
Subsequent Rebel operations were driven by the need to replenish supplies before they could relocate to a new base.<ref name="Atlas1" /> Contact was made with Imperial Overlord [[Ghorin]] of the [[Greater Plooriod Cluster]], who offered his defection and aid along with badly needed shipments of grain. However, Ghorin had no intentions of defecting; his grain was poisoned and he intended to betray the Alliance. Unfortunately for Ghorin, the Alliance discovered his plan, and through [[Operation Grain Snatch]] turned the tables on the Imperial Overlord. Through careful manipulation by the Alliance, Ghorin was seen as a traitor to the Empire; after the success of the operation, Vader paid a visit to Ghorin and, taken in by the Alliance ruse, killed the Overlord.<ref name="X-wing" />

Subsequent to the Yavin evacuation was the [[Reytha campaign]], a Rebel operation on one of the Empire's most productive [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworlds]] to acquire its food supplies. For a time, it succeeded owing to the complicity or incompetence of [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Antes Belladar]]. However, after the capture of Yavin, Darth Vader extracted information from Jan Dodonna about the Rebel operation on [[Reytha]] and dispatched his fleet to the Reytha system. He made contact with Governor Belladar, who sought help against the Rebel forces. Vader was suspicious of the Governor, but nonetheless annihilated the Rebel outpost. After the last of the Rebels were routed, Vader killed Belladar and installed a new Governor.<ref name="Galactic Battlegrounds" />

Meanwhile, in the absence of Dodonna's military leadership and Organa's diplomacy, a rift broke open between the two senior-most political leaders of the Rebellion, Mon Mothma and Garm Bel Iblis. Increasingly wary of Mothma's ambitions, Bel Iblis became critical of her leadership and openly questioned her judgement. The breaking point was reached on the eve of a [[Attack on Milvayne|raid]] on an Imperial base at [[Milvayne/Legends|Milvayne]]. Mothma had given approval for the attack on Milvayne without seeking the consent of Bel Iblis or any of her other military advisors.<ref name="Dark Force Rising" /> 

A livid Bel Iblis requested that she postpone or reconsider the attack, citing his intelligence sources which told him that the purported Milvayne garrison was in fact a heavily fortified Imperial [[Ubiqtorate/Legends|Ubiqtorate]] base. Neither Mothma's nor his own troops were prepared to deal with such military might, he argued. As Mothma overruled him, Bel Iblis questioned her motives in ordering the attack, claiming it was simply part of a grab for power on her part. The two traded thinly veiled insults, with Bel Iblis eventually stating that none of his troops would have a part in the attack. For his dissent, Mothma told Bel Iblis that the Rebellion no longer required his services. In a chasm that would not be closed until [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], Bel Iblis and the [[Garm Bel Iblis's movement|Corellian forces loyal to him]] withdrew from the Alliance, continuing the fight against the Empire on their own accord.<ref name="tts">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref>

[[File:BattleOfTingelDeepspaceBesh-EGTW.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The battle at Deepspace Besh]]
At [[Tingel Deepspace Besh]], the bulk of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance fleet]] were [[Disaster at Deepspace Besh|ambushed]] by the Imperial [[Death Squadron]], suffering near-catastrophe. The Empire had [[Brainwashing|reprogrammed]] the captured Rebel mathematician [[Jorin Sol]] to act as an Imperial agent. After he was rescued from [[Kalist VI/Legends|Kalist VI]] by Luke Skywalker, Sol was cleared to return to duty, but he transmitted the Rebel fleet's location to the Empire, as well as its escape vectors. The Imperial fleet dropped out of hyperspace right after Jorin Sol's attempted assassination of the commanders on board ''[[Rebel One]]'' and began firing on the Rebel fleet, destroying transports and smaller capital ships ''en masse''. However, Sol fought off his programming long enough convince [[Tungo Li]] to order all Rebel ships to scatter into hyperspace rather than follow the now-revealed escape algorithms, which would only bring them to another Imperial fleet. Despite this, much of the fleet was deemed lost, possibly for good.<ref name="Warfare" />

The disaster at Deepspace Besh might have been a mortal blow to the Rebellion, but the Alliance was saved by two things. Firstly, the Bothan political leader [[Borsk Fey'lya]] committed his sizeable faction of the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]] to the Rebellion. Fey'lya had been impressed by the victory at Yavin, but many recognized that he had made his move not for ideological reasons, but to gain more status and power.<ref name="NEC" /> Secondly, at Admiral Ackbar's urging, the Mon Calamari formally entered the war on the side of the Alliance. 

In the aftermath of Yavin, Admiral Ackbar had traveled to his homeworld to convince the Mon Calamari Council to back the Rebellion, and after being rescued by the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] from the Empire at the [[Battle of Daluuj]], the Mon Calamari donated their entire naval strength to the Alliance. Mon Calamari Star Cruisers became the backbone of the Alliance Fleet, under the command of Admiral Ackbar as Supreme Commander. Ackbar reorganized and trained the ragtag group of ships and crews into a fighting force capable of facing the Empire. Ackbar shared with Mon Mothma an unease towards the Alliance's excessive reliance on raids by the Special Forces and Starfighter Corps, while at the same time rejecting the insistence of traditional strategists in the Alliance that the Rebellion should seek to seize territory.<ref name="Warfare" />

Ackbar and Mothma drafted a new "fleet-first" strategy for the Rebellion. The traditionalists in the Alliance hailed Ackbar's reorganization of the fleet into a single armada powerful enough to challenge any [[battle squadron]] of the Imperial Navy, but Ackbar looked at the fleet beyond its tactical role: his strategic thinking was cautious, conservative, and perfectly suited for the Alliance's guerrilla operations. He saw [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] as the decisive force of [[Space warfare/Legends|space warfare]], which, like the mighty ocean predators of his homeworld, would hide in the deeps and strike when the enemy showed weakness. The Alliance Fleet would roam the galaxy, holding back from combat and building up its strength, becoming an ever-greater psychological threat to the New Order and undermining its authority merely by continuing to exist.<ref name="Warfare" />

The Rebellion continued to stage guerrilla strikes on the Empire over the next year, including [[Operation Ram's Head]], which demolished four Star Destroyers in [[Drydock/Legends|drydock]]. The Alliance Fleet remained scattered, however, and the military leadership continued to search for a new base.<ref name="NEC" /> For fear of losing both in a single Imperial strike, Mon Mothma refused to join the Alliance's civilian government with the military leadership. Even though the Alliance's strategists warned that this increased the cost of operations enormously, it was a strategy that paid dividends during the near-disaster at [[Tingel Deepspace Besh]].<ref name="Atlas" /> The jungle planet of [[Thila/Legends|Thila]] was briefly used, but it was abandoned when it was suggested that the Empire would expect the Rebels to move to another jungle world like Yavin 4.<ref name="NEC" />

====The Dark Trooper Project (1 ABY)====
{{Quote|What I unveil today will mark a new era for the Empire. We will be able to decimate the Rebels just as we did the Jedi Knights. At last the Emperor's war will be filled only with the glory and beauty of decisive victory.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Rom Mohc]]|audio=DecisiveVictory-DF.flac|<ref name="Dark Forces" />}}
{{Main|Dark Trooper Project}}
[[File:Dark_Trooper.jpg|thumb|right|150px|A dark trooper attacking a Rebel soldier.]]
The [[Dark Trooper Project]] was a secret Imperial weapons program developed by [[Rom Mohc]] to create the Empire's next generation of stormtroopers. The Dark Trooper was a highly advanced [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that would, in time, succeed the stormtrooper as the main fighting unit of the Imperial Military.<ref name="Dark Forces" />

The project was run from Mohc's production facility, the factory ship ''[[Arc Hammer]]''. After a devastating [[Attack on Tak Base|attack]] on [[Talay/Legends|Talay]], which saw the destruction of [[Tak Base]], the Dark Troopers proved their effectiveness in their first combat operation. Kyle Katarn and [[Jan Ors]], mercenaries under the Alliance's employment, made famous for their previous efforts at collecting the data for the Death Star, were assigned by Mon Mothma to investigate the Dark Trooper Project and stop it at all costs.<ref name="Dark Forces" />

Katarn and Ors succeeded in their mission; infiltrating the ''Arc Hammer'' through Vader's ''Executor'', Katarn killed Mohc in a fierce confrontation and then destroyed the factory ship with several [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] charges. With the ''Arc Hammer'' destroyed and Mohc dead, the project was stymied; so furious was Palpatine that so many credits and resources were wasted on the failed project that he canceled the project entirely. The threat of the Dark Troopers ended.<ref name="Dark Forces" />
