Katarn was assisted in his mission by Crix Madine: after his help during Operation Strike Fear, Madine decided to fully leave the Empire after the release of the [[Candorian plague/Legends|Candorian plague]] on [[Dentaal/Legends|Dentaal]].<ref name="NEC" /> However, he was discovered by the Empire and held on [[Orinackra]], scheduled for execution. The timely arrival of Katarn saw Madine rescued.<ref name="Dark Forces" /> Madine returned to Corellia, where he was scheduled to meet with Carlist Rieekan to finalize his defection to the Alliance. However, the meeting was [[Battle of Corellia (1 ABY)|ambushed]] by the Empire, but due to the intervention of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and the ''Millennium Falcon'', Madine was saved and shuttled off the planet.<ref name="Rogue Squadron">[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']]</ref>

Madine's intimate knowledge of Imperial tactics and operations earned him a spot on the [[Advisory Council (Alliance)|Rebel Alliance Advisory Council]] and role as Supreme Commander of Alliance Special Forces.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" /><ref name="Rules of Engagement">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>

====Renegade Squadron's exploits (0&ndash;1 ABY)====
{{Quote|It didn't matter what they'd been before. All that mattered was that they were willing to fight&mdash;and maybe die&mdash;for the Alliance. I tracked them down and offered them whatever it took. In the end, I found enough of what I was looking for.|[[Col Serra]]|<ref name="Renegade">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]''</ref>}}
[[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]] was originally created by Han Solo shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], but many of its exploits occurred after the Evacuation of Yavin 4. During that battle, Renegade Squadron was instrumental in helping many members of the Alliance escape. Next, they traveled to [[the Graveyard]], the remains of Alderaan, to collect a [[Datacron/Legends|holocron]] made by Bail Organa and encased in [[Phrik/Legends|phrik]], one of the strongest substances in the galaxy, strong enough even to survive the destruction of Alderaan. The holocron had a list of potential bases for the Rebel Alliance, in the case of the evacuation of the base on Yavin IV. After retrieving the holocron and escaping into hyperspace, they met up with Solo on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. Renegade Squadron fought off Imperial forces and IG-88 while Han worked on the ''Millennium Falcon'', escaping with their lives.<ref name="Renegade" />

Shortly afterwards, Admiral Ackbar, who had been investigating [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]] as a potential site for a Rebel base, was captured by Boba Fett and handed over to the Empire. Renegade Squadron quickly acted to [[Battle of Kessel (0 ABY)|rescue]] Ackbar over [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] before relocating to Tatooine in order to find the soldiers who had been captured with Ackbar.<ref name="Renegade" />

The squadron headed back to their base on Boz Pity, but they were unaware that Boba Fett had put a tracker in one of their droids. Fett discovered their base, and a few hours after Renegade Squadron landed on Boz Pity, an Imperial planetary strike force, with an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]], attacked. During the battle, the Squadron learned that Ackbar had been wounded during the battle, and they saved his life by bringing him a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]]. Soon after, they evacuated, still looking for a new base.<ref name="Renegade" />

====Rogue Squadron (0&ndash;3 ABY)====
{{Quote|Well, you know the Rogues. All we need is a ship and rock to land it on.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="X-Wing: Rogue Squadron" />}}
Months after the Battle of Yavin, two of its famous survivors, Luke Skywalker and Wedge Antilles, formed an X-wing squadron that would arguably become the most famous in the galaxy: Rogue Squadron.<ref name="NEC" /> The squadron's origins laid within [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]], then under the command of [[Arhul Narra/Legends|Arhul Narra]], as Rogue Flight, working in tandem with Renegade Flight. Rogue Flight's early missions included aiding evacuation efforts at Yavin 4 and assisting [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] defect to the Alliance on Dantooine.<ref name="Rogue Squadron III" /> Early victories on planets such as Tatooine, [[Barkhesh/Legends|Barkhesh]], and [[Chorax]] earned the Rogues a quick reputation amongst Alliance and Imperial pilots alike, going as far as to convince [[Kasan Moor/Legends|Kasan Moor]], commander of the [[128th TIE Interceptor Squadron]], to defect. Moor's defection led to vital raids on Imperial production facilities, including [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] and [[Kile II]]. These victories did not come without a price, however; [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kohl Seerdon]] noted the Rogues' performance and personally took interest in seeing the Squadron's destruction after their [[Escape from Fest|attack]] on [[Fest/Legends|Fest]], site of Seerdon's research facility. Seerdon launched attacks on Chandrila and Thyferra in retaliation, but his plans were foiled by Rogue Squadron; over the skies of Thyferra, Seerdon's personal attack craft was shot down by Rogue Squadron, ending his reign of terror.<ref name="Rogue Squadron" />

On [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]], a team of scientists working with the Alliance were discovered by Imperial agents. The scientists activated a [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] around the city, temporarily saving them from Imperial reprisal. Two Star Destroyers in orbit opened fire on the shield as ground units, including [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]], descended upon the planet to shut down the shield and capture the scientists. Rogue Squadron was dispatched to Ralltiir to rescue the scientists; led by Skywalker, the Rogues utilized tow cables to destroy the walkers and halted the Imperial offensive. Using explosives constructed by the scientists, the bridges connected to the city were destroyed, thus cutting off Imperial forces from reinforcements to temporarily buy time to escape. During the rescue, [[Sarkli]], a disgruntled Rogue pilot and nephew to Imperial Admiral [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]], defected to the Empire, taking with him one of the scientists. Despite the last-minute surprise defection, the Rebels escaped with the surviving scientists.<ref name="Rogue Squadron III" />

During a convoy escort relocating supplies to Echo Base, an [[Battle of Derra IV|ambush]] by Imperial forces at [[Derra IV/Legends|Derra IV]] all but wiped out Renegade Flight, killing Commander Narra.<ref name="Rogue Squadron II">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]''</ref> As a result, Rogue Flight was transformed into Rogue Squadron, and Luke Skywalker was given full command of the squadron.<ref name="Warfare" />

===The Empire strikes back (2&ndash;3 ABY)===
[[File:HothGreaterJavin-TEA.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]], site of the Alliance's [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]]]

====Death Squadron (2&ndash;3 ABY)====
{{Quote|Set your course for the Hoth System.|Darth Vader upon finding the location of the Rebel base on Hoth|<ref name="Episode V" />}}
{{Main|Death Squadron/Legends}}
Eventually, Mon Mothma agreed to establish the new Rebel command headquarters at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the frozen planet of Hoth. The planet seemed like a superb find for the Alliance: located in the isolated [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] in the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]], Hoth was situated on the [[Ison Trade Corridor/Legends|Ison Corridor]], a decaying hyperspace bypass of the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] whose only common destination was [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. The difficulties of traversing the [[Ivax Nebula/Legends|Ivax Nebula]] and the debris field of the [[Ison system/Legends|Ison]] Rimward meant that ships invariably reached Bespin from the Coreward end of the Corridor from [[Indellian]]. Very few ships passed beyond Bespin to [[Anoat/Legends|Anoat]], Hoth, or [[Ison/Legends|Ison]] itself. Hoth was therefore secluded, largely unknown, but gave the Alliance quick access to the Corellian Trade Spine for raiding.<ref name="Atlas" /> Nevertheless, the base commander, General Carlist Rieekan, demanded a permanent state of readiness to evacuate should Echo Base be discovered.<ref name="Warfare" />

Rieekan had good reason to worry: inspired by the victory at Yavin IV, many worlds had begun to pledge their allegiance&mdash;openly or behind closed doors&mdash;to the Alliance cause. Some planets, such as [[Zaloriis/Legends|Zaloriis]], instead fought for their own independence from Imperial rule. After the Zaloran declaration of independence, they battled against their Imperial rulers, capturing [[Major General]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] of the Imperial Army in the process. Vader descended upon Zaloriis and enacted swift devastation upon the populace; during the battle, Veers was rescued and, after analysis of the Zaloran archives, the Empire discovered that the new Rebel base was located in the vicinity of [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]].<ref name="Galactic Battlegrounds" />

[[File:SW_Executor_01.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] on the hunt for the Rebel base]]
With this new information in hand, Vader assembled a personal [[Task force/Legends|task force]]; [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]]. Led by the ''Executor'', it was formally composed of five other Star Destroyers but had the authority to attach warships from other [[Sector Group/Legends|sector groups]] if necessary. Beginning at [[Centares/Legends|Centares]], Vader intensified his search for the Rebel base and his new obsession, the pilot who had destroyed the Death Star who bore the name of Vader's former self, Luke Skywalker.<ref name="Warfare" />

Death Squadron advanced through the Outer Rim along the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]], destroying smugglers' hideaways and [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowports]]. The strategy, developed by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], was to disrupt the Rebels' smuggling-based supply network and so discover the location of Alliance High Command. Captured smugglers were interrogated, and a battle in the [[Ulkantha asteroids]] tipped Death Squadron off to a Rebel-affiliated [[Unidentified Sakiyan smuggling ring|Sakiyan smuggling ring]] operating out of the [[Syvris shadowport]]. Thrawn's analysis of Rebel equipment captured at the [[Battle of the Poln system]] indicated that Rebels had chosen a barren, cold planet as their next base of operations.<ref name="COC" /> Additionally, Thrawn uncovered a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] smuggling operation on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] and masterminded the interception of a Rebel supply convoy at [[Derra IV/Legends|Derra IV]]. The [[Battle of Derra IV]] was a disaster for the Alliance: the 181st Imperial Fighter Group led by Soontir Fel severely disrupted Rebel supply lines and killed Commander Arhul Narra of Renegade Flight.<ref name="Warfare" />

By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Death Squadron's terror strategy began to have results: Rebel forces in many Outer Rim sectors abandoned their bases and resistance cells dispersed. Admiral Ackbar relocated the Alliance Fleet repeatedly. The Derra IV convoy's supplies had been ticketed for Echo Base on Hoth in the Greater Javin, and the intel recovered from the convoy allowed Death Squadron to narrow its search to the Outer Rim sectors of the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]].<ref name="Warfare" /> Thousands of [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] were dispatched throughout the region in an attempt to discover the Rebel base. Reports came in daily from the probes, but many turned up smugglers' encampments, uncharted settlements, or otherwise nothing of value. However, then-Captain [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]] of the ''Executor'' came upon a report from the Hoth system; after analysis of the feed by Piett, and then Vader, Hoth was confirmed as the site of the Rebel base.<ref name="Episode V" />

====The Battle of Hoth (3 ABY)====
{{Quote|As the Rebels fled, the 501st gathered around a burning bunker and let out a cheer that shook the stars. The Rebellion was done, the Death Star was being rebuilt, bigger than ever. Order had finally returned to the Galaxy, in no small part due to the efforts of the fighting men of the 501st.|A 501st member's entry in a journal|<ref name="Battlefront II" />}}
{{Main|Battle of Hoth/Legends}}
[[File:Snowspeeders-ST.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Snowspeeder/Legends|Rebel snowspeeders]] approaching Imperial [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]]]
Advancing from the [[Qeimet system/Legends|Qeimet system]], Death Squadron was reinforced by four Star Destroyers from the [[Juris sector/Legends|Juris sector]] and traveled down the [[Ison Trade Corridor/Legends|Ison Corridor]] into the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]]. The [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] commenced soon after, with the Rebels fighting a stalling effort to allow base personnel and command to evacuate with as many supplies as possible and regroup with the main Alliance fleet. If Imperial Admiral [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]], who was soon relieved as commander of Darth Vader's [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] for his error, had come out of hyperspace further from the Hoth system, the Rebels could have been caught unaware and bombarded from orbit, but instead they erected a small [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]]. Vader ordered General Maximilian Veers to lead a [[Walker/Legends|walker]] assault on Echo Base, which the Rebels could not effectively counter.<ref name="Episode V" />

The Rebel base was overrun and destroyed, seventeen of thirty escaping Rebel [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|medium transports]] were totally destroyed as they attempted to traverse the Imperial blockade, and an intense pursuit of the escaping ''Millennium Falcon'' through the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]] was conducted on Vader's seemingly erratic orders. Despite much Imperial effort, the ''Falcon'' escaped to [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], seeking asylum from Han's old friend, [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. Unknown to Solo and his companions, the Empire had forced Calrissian into cooperating with its efforts to capture the ''Falcon''{{'s}} outlaw crew. Vader, bounty hunter Boba Fett, and a squadron of stormtroopers apprehended the Rebels and prepared a trap for Luke Skywalker, whom Vader knew would investigate.<ref name="Episode V" />

As the Alliance Fleet regrouped at a secret point above the galactic plane, Luke Skywalker, under the advice of the [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] of Obi-Wan Kenobi, had traveled to [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] and had become a Jedi apprentice to Jedi Master Yoda. Through the Force, Luke became aware of his friends' suffering and, despite the pleas of Yoda and Kenobi to stay and complete his Jedi training, left Dagobah for Cloud City in an attempt to save his friends, who ended up saving him after he confronted Darth Vader. Vader also revealed to Luke in their battle that he was his father. At the last second, the friends escaped aboard the ''Millennium Falcon'', though Han Solo was taken in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] on Tatooine by the bounty hunter Fett.<ref name="Episode V" />

====New superweapons====
{{Quote|Worse than a ''Death Star?''"''<br />''"''I'm afraid so, Commander. They've taken the Death Star's main offensive battery, the ionic cannon&mdash;and have built around it a set of engines and defensive shield generators unmatched by anything we've ever encountered! This weapon has been christened "the Tarkin" and should it ever become operational&mdash;we may as well place our own hands in the Empire's shackles!|Commander Luke Skywalker and General Carlist Rieekan|<ref name="Star Wars 51">[[Star Wars (1977) 51|''Star Wars'' (1977) 51]]</ref>}}
[[File:The_Tarkin_by_Stephan_Martiniere.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Tarkin takes shape in the Patriim system.]]
The Battle of Yavin was not the end of the Tarkin Doctrine. Following the loss of the first Death Star, the Empire began the construction of the [[Tarkin (superweapon)|''Tarkin'']], a stripped-down [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] testbed named in honor of the martyred Grand Moff. Assembled in the [[Patriim system/Legends|Patriim system]], it was destroyed by a Rebel strike team led by the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] shortly after the Battle of Hoth.<ref name="Warfare" /> The ''Tarkin'' fired its superlaser only once in its existence: to destroy the planet [[Aeten II/Legends|Aeten II]]'' to release [[Stygium/Legends|Stygium crystals]]'' for Grand Admiral [[Martio Batch]]'s [[TIE/ph "Phantom" Multi-Role Stealth Starfighter/Legends|Phantom TIE Project]].<ref name="Rebel Assault II">''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault II: The Hidden Empire]]''</ref>

Batch's project sought to develop invisible starfighters utilizing [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking]] technology developed from Stygium crystals.<ref name="Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|66|Who's Who: Imperial Grand Admirals}}</ref> Vader was impressed by the Phantom's demonstration in the [[Dreighton Nebula/Legends|Dreighton Nebula]], and mass-production of the starfighter began at a [[Imdaar Alpha research station|factory]] attached to [[Imdaar Alpha]]. However, [[Ru Murleen]] and [[Rookie One]] were able to steal a TIE Phantom and infiltrate the [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Terror]]''; through their actions they destroyed the ''Terror'' and the TIE Phantom production facility, putting an end to the short-lived Phantom project. At the conclusion of the mission, the Alliance sought to mass-produce their own Phantoms based on the starfighter retrieved by Rookie One; however, this plan was quickly eliminated, as Vader activated the self-destruct on all remaining TIE Phantoms, thus ensuring the end to the TIE Phantom line.<ref name="Rebel Assault II" />

Admiral [[Mils Giel]] launched his project of a more arcane nature soon afterwards, aimed at using the mysterious [[Teezl]] creature to enhance Imperial communications and fleet coordination greatly. A [[secret armada]] led by the [[Helmsman (battlecruiser)|''Helmsman'']] was assembled to transport the creature from the [[Valtha Divide/Legends|Valtha Divide]] to Coruscant. In response, the Alliance launched [[Operation Earplug]]. The first part of the plan concerned the procurement of four black-market TIE fighters, which would be modified into hyperspace-capable starfighters and used by the [[Flying Bantha Squadron]] in subsequent missions. As part of their test run, the squadron's TIE fighters were used in an attack on [[Spindrift Station]], an Imperial outpost said to hold the route coordinates for the fleet transporting the Teezl. With the coordinates secured, the entrance codes to the armada were next. These would be secured in an ambush on a TIE patrol, near the Imperial fleet's flight path. They assigned four Flying Bantha Squadron pilots to perform the final task of the operation: an almost certain suicidal infiltration mission that would culminate in the destruction of the Teezl. 

Gaining access, the Rebel TIEs split off, chose random ships to target, and began the mayhem and confusion which would spread throughout the Imperial fleet. The commanders of the damaged vessels followed standard procedure. They counterattacked, but since it was unclear which ships had hit the targets, the warships lashed out randomly, hitting dozens of TIE fighters and other capital ships. Admiral Giel quickly realized the Rebel attack plan and thus ordered the Teezl to fill all available comm channels with static, to prevent further communication between the Rebels. The Teezl's jamming forced Luke Skywalker to rely only on the Force to distinguish friend from foe, as he finally reached the area of Giel's vessel where the Teezl was located. Being fired upon by defensive guns, he noticed a TIE fighter between him and the flagship. Using the Force to identify the pilot as an enemy, he fired on it and cleared the way for the main, powered-up shot. It struck the vessel, smashing through the hull and killing the Teezl instantly. After the [[Battle of the secret armada|battle]], Luke fled the area, using a patrol ship as a temporary shield from pursuing enemy fighters before escaping into hyperspace. As a result of the loss of the Teezl, Giel was demoted to [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] and reassigned.<ref name="Star Wars 61">[[Star Wars (1977) 61|''Star Wars'' (1977) 61]]</ref>

====Imperial explorations====
Perhaps the Empire's most enduring and dangerous military creations were not weapons but explorations. Palpatine opened vast swathes of territory to new explorations, most significantly the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] and the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. New routes like the [[Byss Run/Legends|Byss Run]] were blazed into the Galactic Core at incredible expense and were kept open with non-mass [[S-thread booster/Legends|S-thread boosters]]. Worlds like the Emperor's redoubt at [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] and the headquarters of the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]] at [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]] were settled by enthusiastic Imperial citizens, and the region remained fanatically loyal to the Empire for years afterwards. The Deep Core was a refuge for Imperial forces after Endor, the site of the rebirth of Emperor Palpatine into a clone body, and he led [[Operation Shadow Hand]] from it. The Deep Core was the refuge of the Empire's last significant [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] before they abandoned it for the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] in the Outer Rim.<ref name="Atlas" />

The other significant region of Imperial exploration was the Unknown Regions, the vast quarter of the galaxy west of the core that had always defied colonization.<ref name="Atlas" /> Following his discovery by [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]]'' in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]]'' Imperial officer Mitth'raw'nuruodo, better remembered as Thrawn, spent years charting this region of his birth at Palpatine's personal order, for which he received the rank of Grand Admiral. From a fortress known as the [[Hand of Thrawn]] on [[Nirauan/Legends|Nirauan]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], Thrawn established a Loyalist confederation known as the [[Empire of the Hand]]. Re-establishing contact with the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]], Thrawn won the admiration of many young Chiss with his defeats of a myriad of threats, including the encroaching [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. He returned to the Unknown Regions shortly before Endor, continuing his mapping mission and settling a vast new swath of territory and resources that could fuel the Empire. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], before he returned to the galaxy one last time to fight his [[Thrawn campaign|final campaign]], Thrawn swore to Voss Parck, now his second in command, that if he died he would return 10 years later.<ref name="Hand of Thrawn">''[[Star Wars: The Hand of Thrawn Duology]]''</ref>

====The Sepan campaign (3 ABY)====
{{Quote|Attention all Ripoblus and Dimok craft, this is Imperial space. You are hereby ordered to stand down or face the consequences!|An Imperial officer to [[Dimok (people)|Dimok]] and [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]] forces|<ref name="TIE Fighter" />}}
{{Main|Sepan campaign}}
[[File:Protector_TIE.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A TIE fighter returning to the ''Victory I''-class Star Destroyer ''Protector'' after the First Battle of the Sapan system.]]
Concurrent to Death Squadron's operations against Hoth was the [[Sepan campaign]], a series of battles initiated by the Empire in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] with the objective of ending the [[Sepan Civil War]], which had raged for nearly three decades between the [[Dimok (people)|Dimoks]] and the [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]]. Imperial forces, led by Admiral [[Harkov]], started by intercepting both Dimok and Ripoblus attack forces, halting their attacks on one another. Unfortunately for the Empire, the result was that both the Dimoks and the Ripoblus aligned and declared war on the Empire, an ironic turn of events.<ref name="TIE Fighter" />

After a series of battles, the Empire defeated the [[Sepan]] forces and forced a peace treaty upon the two, ending the civil war. Harkov urged cooperation with the Empire for greater prosperity for all.<ref name="TIE Fighter" /> Under Imperial rule, hostilities ended in the [[Sepan system/Legends|Sepan system]], but in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], with the ongoing strife brought upon by the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], tensions flared up once more, and the system would find itself in civil war again.<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref>

===The Alliance regroups (3&ndash;4 ABY)===
====Task Force Vengeance (3 ABY)====
{{Main|Spreading the Rebellion}}
[[File:SSD_Vengeance.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Task Force Vengeance attacked by Rebel forces]]
The Battle of Hoth crippled the Rebellion, with untold amounts of military materiel being lost aboard the 17 destroyed transports.<ref name="Atlas" /> Many stormtroopers within the Empire's 501st Legion even believed they had ended the Rebellion.<ref name="Battlefront II" /> Though Alliance Command and the fleet stayed intact, more disasters were to follow. After the formation of [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force Vengeance]], the Rebel Alliance was forced to give up its permanent assets in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] in favor of the more remote and less strictly controlled [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]]. In the opening [[Evacuation of Gelgelar|battle]] of the campaign, many assets in the Elrood sector were evacuated, most notably, the [[XQ5 Platform]]-turned-hospital ''[[Hormuuz]]'' in the [[Gelgelar system/Legends|Gelgelar system]]. Most places avoided Imperial attention, but ''Hormuuz'' attracted the attention of Admiral [[Wooyou Senn]], who deployed a strike team to capture any Rebels in the system. Although the Rebels, who had learned to react quickly after losing over half of its Echo Base assets to Death Squadron in the Hoth system, avoided major losses, many [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 starfighters]] were sacrificed to cover the escape of the base staff, and several vital [[Class-A cargo container|cargo containers]] were left floating in space.<ref name="Balance of Power">[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter#Expansion pack|''Star Wars: X-wing vs TIE Fighter'']]</ref>

After [[Attack on the Gelgelar system|stocking up]] on consumables and warheads, the Alliance went on to learn their enemy's strength&mdash;a [[Mission to Almaran|reconnaissance mission]] by Rogue Squadron scanned the ships of Task Force Vengeance and destroyed any freighter carrying warhead supplies. This culminated in a [[Skirmish near Almaran|diversionary strike]] by the [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|Calamari Cruiser]] [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']], intended to lure away some of the Imperial warships into an [[Ambush in the Goff system|ambush]] set in the [[Goff system/Legends|Goff system]]. Rogue Squadron [[Battle of Swellen|led a strike team to capture]] an Imperial [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|interdictor]] while it was undergoing repairs. The attempt was successful, and despite the Empire's [[First attack on the Peregrine|attempts]] to scuttle the ''[[Compellor/Legends|Compellor]]'', the Rogues brought the ship safely to the [[Mobetta system/Legends|Mobetta system]]. By maintaining tight patrols around the factory, ''[[Gallofree]]'', the Rebels [[Second attack on the Peregrine|kept]] the modifications performed on the [[Modified Strike Cruiser|''Strike''-class cruiser]] [[Peregrine (Strike-class)|''Peregrine'']] a secret, prepping the ''Compellor'' for its final mission. The baptism of fire for the ''Peregrine'' came shortly thereafter in the [[Derilyn system/Legends|Derilyn system]], where it [[Ambush in the Derilyn system|assisted]] ''Liberty'' in pinning down and destroying a reinforcement and resupply fleet headed for Task Force Vengeance. Meanwhile, an Imperial strike force [[Retreat from Gallofree|located]] the ''Compellor,'' which blew up in full view of the Star Destroyers [[Titan (Imperial-class)|''Titan'']] and [[Juggernaut (Star Destroyer)|''Juggernaut'']], according to the Rebels' plan, leading the Imperials to believe that neither they nor the Alliance had access to [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity well]] technology anymore.<ref name="Balance of Power" />

In the closing days of the campaign, Task Force Vengeance was already showing the effects of raids against their supply lines. In a last-ditch effort, Senn [[Battle of Dega|tried]] to acquire supplies from the traitorous [[Airam (group)|Airam]] clan leader [[Ilay]], but was foiled by the efforts of Rogue and [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadrons]]. The Alliance, intent on wearing down the remainders of the Imperial task force slowly but steadily, did not expect Admiral Senn to know the location of their most crucial asset in the Airam sector by this time: the shipyard ''[[Calenz]]''. The [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Vengeance (Executor-class)/Legends|''Vengeance'']], accompanied by the Star Destroyer [[Rage (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Rage'']], attacked the shipyard directly. Not even the valiant efforts of Rogue and Green Squadrons, the Calamari Cruiser ''Liberty'' and an Airam [[Ramming/Legends|suicidal]] armada could prevent the destruction of ''Calenz'' at the [[Battle of Nocto]], but despite the hefty blow to its Airam sector infrastructure, the Rebel fleet did destroy the last remnants of Task Force Vengeance, including the titular Star Dreadnought, and kill Admiral Senn.<ref name="Balance of Power" />

====Rogue Squadron's exploits (3 ABY)====
Rogue Squadron's daring operations during the Galactic Civil War became the stuff of legend. Following the [[Occupation of Bespin|subjugation of Bespin]], the Rebel Alliance set out to save any Rebel prisoners from the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. Rogue Squadron [[Battle near the Maw|besieged]] a small [[Maw Imperial Prison|Imperial detention facility]] in the [[Maw Cluster/Legends|Maw]] system, freeing all captives. [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] and [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]] were dispatched to [[Calast]], where they fell upon the Imperial prisoner transport ''[[VTR-LX]]'' while it was refueling. The ship managed to escape to a nearby Imperial base in the [[Bundil system/Legends|Bundil system]], but was pursued by the Rebels and [[Rescue at Bundil II|successfully raided]].

Rogue Squadron provided air support to Rebel SpecForces during a [[raid on Bespin]] just prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. The battle raged both in the air and on the floating settlements of the gas giant, starting at the de facto capital of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], and moving outwards across the various gas refineries as the Rebels continued to gain ground. A point of confusion during the battle was the use of cloud cars on both sides, which led to several incidents of friendly fire. Wedge Antilles and Rogue Squadron attacked with their primary objective being to secure as many [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna gas]] platforms as possible. After destroying a large majority of the Empire's control systems, the squadron provided aerial support for those fighting on the ground, by disabling the city's power generators, which in turn deactivated the Imperial turbolasers, gun turrets, and communications. After the combined effort of the SpecForce and Rogue Squadron, the SpecForce moved on to capture the main Imperial mining platform. The Rebel forces landed and secured the gas extractor, and pushed the Imperials back to the other side of the platform. The Rebel forces moved in and captured the Imperial docks and landing platforms, trapping them in the main command center. Y-wings bombed the building, X-wings destroyed starfighters before they could lift off, and the enemy numbers dwindled. Teams of SpecForce soldiers moved in on the command building and secured it.<ref name="Battlefront" />

When the Rebels discovered that prisoners taken from the Battle of Hoth were being held at Bakura, the Alliance sent Rogue Squadron to [[Raid at Bakura|rescue them]]. After further prisoner rescue, a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] disabled [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Hobbie Klivian's]] X-wing, sending him crashing on the surface of the planet. Wedge journeyed down onto the planet in a stolen TIE Bomber to pick him up. However, hundreds of Bakuran heavy missile batteries littered the surface. Using his bomber's lock on concussion missiles, Wedge broke through the defenses and saved Hobbie. Upon arrival back in orbit, he noticed that debris littered the area. Crix Madine informed him that an Imperial vessel made off with a batch of scientists and destroyed the rest of the transports, and it seemed he was headed toward Geonosis.<ref name="Rogue Squadron III" />

The Rebellion stole an Imperial [[TIE/hu "Hunter" Multi-Role Starfighter|TIE Hunter]] in order to destroy an [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]]. The plan was to use an empty Rebel transport and have ram it into one of the shield generator command decks. The Empire found out the transport was a decoy and sent TIE fighters to destroy it but did not succeed. The frigate ''Redemption'' and several other squadrons, and two [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]], arrived to cover the attack on the generator. The generator was deactivated by Wedge Antilles' [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]], but he abandoned his TIE for a more stable [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing interceptor]]. Antilles destroyed the shield generator and the Super Star Destroyer. Though this was a clear victory, the Emperor believed it would make the Rebels overconfident in the upcoming battles, thinking ahead to his plan to trap the Rebels at Endor.<ref name="Rogue Squadron III" />

====Rescue of Han Solo (3&ndash;4 ABY)====
{{Quote|I am taking Captain Solo and his friends. You can either profit by this or be destroyed. It's your choice, but I warn you not to underestimate my powers.|Luke Skywalker, to Jabba Desilijic Tiure|audio=IAmTakingCaptainSolo.flac|<ref name="Episode VI" />}}
{{Main|Battle of Gall|Rescue of Han Solo/Legends}}
[[File:BattleofGall-SOTE.png|thumb|left|220px|The [[Battle of Gall]]]]
The Rebel Alliance fought a small campaign to recover Han Solo, who after his capture on Cloud City remained imprisoned in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] for nearly a year between [[3 ABY/Legends|3]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. The smuggler [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] confronted [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|IG-88]] on Ord Mantell and learned the whereabouts of Boba Fett, who had Han Solo as a captive; he was repairing his ship on [[Gall/Legends|Gall]]. Fett, the Rebels and the Empire engaged in the [[Battle of Gall]] as Luke Skywalker led the attempt to rescue Solo. Rogue Squadron and Rendar attacked Fett on the moon. However, this rescue mission was confounded by the presence of an [[Imperial Enclave]], with two Star Destroyers on patrol. Despite the piloting skills of the Rogues and Rendar, the Imperial numbers were too great, and Fett escaped.

Fett had to deal with other attacks by envious bounty hunters seeking to claim the money on Solo's head before he arrived on Tatooine to deliver Solo to Jabba the Hutt.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire" /> Consequently, Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa planned what would be their final rescue attempt. [[Siege of Jabba's Palace|The first phase]] had Lando Calrissian infiltrate [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]], disguised as the guard Tamtel Skreej, as a contingency should anything go wrong. The second phase involved sending R2-D2 and C-3PO to the palace to peacefully offer Jabba the opportunity to release Han, with the droids themselves as a gift. When this failed, phase three involved Leia, posing as the bounty hunter [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]], delivering a supposedly captured Chewbacca to Jabba for a bounty. Leia would have then freed Han in the night, released Chewbacca and escaped with them and Lando. When Jabba saw through the attempted rescue and captured all three (excluding Lando, who remained in disguise), they were forced to move to the final phase. Luke Skywalker entered the palace and, by means of several [[Force power/Legends|Force techniques]], made his way to Jabba's throne room. He underestimated Jabba, however, and, after killing [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|Jabba's pet]] [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]], wound up captured and sentenced to death in the gullet of the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]], along with Han and Chewbacca.<ref name="Episode VI" />

Luke, Han and Chewbacca were taken to the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]] in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]]. They were transported on a [[Bantha-II cargo skiff/Legends|desert skiff]] while Jabba and his minions traveled on [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']], Jabba's [[Luxury-class sail barge|luxury sail barge]]. Once there, Luke freed himself with the help of R2-D2, and a [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|pitched struggle]] saw the destruction of Jabba and [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|his criminal empire]], as well as the supposed demise of Boba Fett. Afterwards, Luke, Leia, Han, Chewbacca, Lando, and the droids escaped unharmed and made their way back to the Rebel fleet.<ref name="Episode VI" /><ref name="The Mandalorian Armor">''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]''</ref>

===Alliance triumphant (3&ndash;4 ABY)===
====The Second Death Star====
{{Main|Death Star II/Legends}}
[[File:DeathStar2.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The second Death Star.]]
After the destruction of the first Death Star, Palpatine ordered a new one to be designed, [[Bevel Lemelisk]], the chief designer, removed the thermal exhaust port in favor of millions of millimeter-wide channels to disperse heat, eliminating the fatal flaw present in its predecessor. Additionally, the [[Death Star II/Legends|Second Death Star]] was vastly larger than its predecessor, and powerful enough to reduce its firing cycle to once every three minutes, allowing it to target capital ships. Once completed, the new battlestation would be almost invincible.<ref name="Warfare" />

However, since [[Despayre]] had been destroyed as the first Death Star's test,<ref name="NEC" /> another isolated planetary body was needed as a construction site; [[Brenn Tantor]], a General in the Imperial Army, was ordered to scout out a new world for the Empire to occupy for construction of a secret project. Tantor settled on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], the forested moon of a [[Endor (planet)/Legends|gas giant]] in the isolated, backwater [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]], and led a light scout force to the planet's moon. However, the mission went astray from the start; native [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] assaulted the scout force. Tantor was reluctant to engage, as he did not know if they were indeed hostile or just nervous natives defending their territory. But Tantor was overruled by his superior, [[Grand General/Legends|Grand General]] [[Malcor Brashin]], and Tantor eliminated the Ewok threat and secured a site for Imperial engineers that would serve as the shield generator of the Death Star II and base for the Empire.<ref name="Force Commander">''[[Star Wars: Force Commander]]''</ref> Subsequently, an obscure [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Silvestri Trace]] was expanded at huge expense to create the [[Sanctuary Pipeline/Legends|Sanctuary Pipeline]], a corridor for supply and construction ships to begin the development of the Second Death Star.<ref name="Warfare" />

====The road to Endor (3&ndash;4 ABY)====
{{Main|Raid on the Suprosa|Battle of Kothlis|Mission to Prefsbelt IV}}
[[File:Rebelsonkothlis.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Battle of Kothlis.]]
Emperor Palpatine intended the Second Death Star to be more than a symbol of the Tarkin Doctrine. Since Yavin, the Galactic Civil War had been a disaster for the Rebel Alliance, and a [[4 ABY/Legends|year after Hoth]], the Rebels were still trying to regroup. Palpatine conceived the Second Death Star as part of a colossal trap to draw Admiral Ackbar's fleet into a final, decisive confrontation where it could be destroyed.<ref name="Warfare" /> Historians later remarked that had it not been for the disaster of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], the Rebels might not have been so desperate as to risk everything for a decisive battle at Endor.<ref name="Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref>

Palpatine deliberately leaked information about the Second Death Star to the Bothan Spynet through the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal organization. The Bothans learned that the [[Death Star II plans]] were being secretly transported on a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], the ''[[Suprosa]]''. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Luke Skywalker, along with the smuggler Dash Rendar, traveled to Bothawui and met their contact [[Koth Melan]]<ref name="Shadows of the Empire" /> in 3.5 ABY<ref name="NEC" /> to train the Bothan's [[Blue Squadron (Bothan)|Blue Squadron]] to [[Raid on the Suprosa|intercept the freighter]]. The Rebels intercepted the freighter, which was heavily armed, and lost six ships in the raid. Skywalker disabled the freighter,<ref name="Shadows of the Empire" /> and Rendar boarded and took the data core containing the plans. The plans were then brought to the Bothan colony [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]].<ref name="SOTE vg">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' video game]]</ref>

[[File:Korriban18.jpg|thumb|right|280px|[[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron's]] [[Battle of Korriban (Galactic Civil War)|assault]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]]]
After a [[Battle of Kothlis|battle at Kothlis]], the plans were smuggled offworld to Alliance Command, confirming the battlestation's existence but resulting in the deaths of many Bothans. The Rebels additionally learned that the Emperor himself would be overseeing the final construction of the Death Star.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire" /> After an attempt by Renegade Squadron to ambush Palpatine on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] failed,<ref name="Renegade" /> the Rebel Alliance saw this as an immense opportunity to deal the Empire a mortal blow.<ref name="Episode VI" />

As a preliminary to the battle, the Rebels aimed at stealing the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class Imperial Shuttle]] [[Tydirium/Legends|''Tydirium'']] to allow a strike team to infiltrate Endor and disable the Death Star's protective shield. General Madine, after their initial attempt at stealing the [[Tydirium/Legends|''Tydirium'']] backfired and resulted in it being confiscated by the Imperials, ordered Wedge Antilles to go to the Imperial Academy on [[Prefsbelt IV/Legends|Prefsbelt IV]] and steal the shuttle. Wedge neutralized/evaded all the Imperial scanners and made his way to the Imperial airbase. Wedge infiltrated the base and stole the Imperial shuttle. He blew his cover at the shuttle's hangar, and later made a rendezvous with reinforcements who escorted the stolen ''Tydirium'' to safety.<ref name="Rogue Squadron II" />

In the meantime, [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], reinforced to a strength of over thirty Star Destroyers, assembled at Endor to await the Rebel attack. Elsewhere the Empire assembled massive invasion fleets on the borders of [[Calamari sector/Legends|Mon Calamari space]] and Mon Mothma's homeworld of Chandrila. Palpatine planned to smash Ackbar's fleet at Endor between the Death Star and Death Squadron while his fleets fixed the Mon Cals and Chandrila in place. Once the Death Star was completed, it would move to these worlds and destroy them to finally end the Rebellion.<ref name="Warfare" />

====The Battle of Endor (4 ABY)====
{{Quote|The Emperor has made a critical error and the time for our attack has come.|[[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]|<ref name="Episode VI" />}}
{{Main|Battle of Endor/Legends}}
[[File:Battle_of_Endor.jpg|thumb|left|230px|The [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] rages in space.]]
After freeing Han Solo on Tatooine, Luke Skywalker, Leia Organa, Chewbacca, and Lando Calrissian (along with the droids R2-D2 and C-3PO) met up with the Rebel Alliance near the system of Sullust. The Rebels were amassing their entire fleet for the strike on the Second Death Star. Admiral Gial Ackbar along with General Crix Madine developed the plans for the battle: The Death Star was protected by a [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]] generated from the forest moon of Endor. Han Solo, Chewbacca, Leia Organa, Luke Skywalker, R2-D2, and C-3PO led an expedition in the [[Tydirium/Legends|''Tydirium'']] to disable the shield and enable the attack. Once on Endor, however, Luke turned himself in to Darth Vader, his father, hoping to rescue him from the clutches of the Emperor and the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Meanwhile, the [[Endor strike team/Legends|Endor strike team]] was intercepted by [[Tempest Force/Legends|Tempest Force]], and the Alliance Fleet was trapped in space between the Death Star and Death Squadron, which had hidden in wait on the far side of Endor.<ref name="Episode VI" />

Vader took Skywalker aboard the uncompleted Death Star and before the Emperor, who attempted to lure him to the dark side by placing him in combat with Vader, whom he defeated. However, instead of killing Vader, he renounced the dark side by declaring himself a Jedi, like his father before him. Palpatine then attempted to kill him with a shower of deadly [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], but Darth Vader, becoming Anakin Skywalker once again, threw the Emperor into a reactor core shaft, killing him. Palpatine's spirit survived, however, and fled to his secure redoubt of Byss in the Deep Core, where it began a period of rebirth into a new clone body. On the Forest Moon, the Rebels deactivated the shield by destroying the entire shield bunker with sequencer charges. The Battle of Endor culminated with the destruction of the Death Star, although Skywalker escaped with Anakin's body. Grand Admiral [[Nial Declann]] was killed when the Death Star was destroyed as he used [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]] to direct the Imperial fleet, throwing the fleet into disarray. Admiral [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]] died when the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] was destroyed, while Grand Admiral [[Osvald Teshik]] unsuccessfully attempted to rally the fleet and fought on alone before being captured by the Rebels. He would later be executed by the New Republic for war crimes.<ref name="NEC" /> Meanwhile, the ranking officer, Captain [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] of the Star Destroyer [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']], ordered a retreat to [[Annaj/Legends|Annaj]]. Despite this tremendous Rebel victory however, many long years would go by before the Galactic Empire truly surrendered.<ref name="Episode VI" />

===After Endor (4 ABY)===
====The Empire fragments====
{{Main|Warlord/Legends|Defense Declarations}}
[[File:Theed.png|thumb|right|200px|An uprising on Naboo, following the Empire's defeat at the Battle of Endor.]]
Following the Rebel Alliance's victory at the Battle of Endor and the death of Emperor Palpatine and Darth Vader, riots and uprisings took place on a multitude of Imperial-held worlds, as the news spread across the galaxy. Even Palpatine's homeworld of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] could not escape a [[Rally on Naboo/Legends|liberation struggle]]. On Coruscant, billions reveled in their newfound freedom, and [[Coruscant uprising|riots]] broke out from the [[Alien/Legends|non-Human]]-dominated sectors in which all Imperial patrols were attacked in the streets, statues of Palpatine were toppled and other Imperial symbols were desecrated.<ref name="Episode VI" />

In the midst of all the celebrating and rioting, Imperial authorities ordered a massive crackdown on the rebellious elements in the city-planet's population and gave full power to the local military force to end the uprising and restore order to the system. The military retaliation was horrendous and the death tolls rose as the Empire struck down the insurrectionists and brought the populace back under its control. Following this, [[Grand Vizier/Legends|Grand Vizier]] [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] assumed the title of Galactic Emperor and established control over Coruscant.<ref name="NEC" />

However, Emperor Palpatine's death provoked a crisis of leadership within the Empire: Palpatine had never laid down a succession plan, and various members of the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Inner Circle]] opposed Pestage's reign. He would later be betrayed by the [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]]. Meanwhile, Death Squadron regrouped and repaired at [[Annaj/Legends|Annaj]], the capital of the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]], and its remaining leadership fell to debating the next course of action. Gilad Pellaeon urged a return to Endor: three-quarters of the Rebel fleet holding position at the moon was in urgent need of repairs and he believed that despite their losses, Death Squadron remained powerful enough to overcome them. Pellaeon was countermanded by Admiral [[Blitzer Harrsk]], who regarded Pellaeon's tactical command as nullified with the end of the battle. Command now belonged to Admiral [[Adye Prittick]], who dithered for so long over the decision that Harrsk broke with the fleet, taking the [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]] ''[[Ilthmar's Fist]]'' and five Star Destroyers into the Deep Core until a clear chain of command could be established. Further defections to the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] left Death Squadron with just twelve Star Destroyers, a force that Prittick judged too small to guarantee victory. He ordered a withdrawal to [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul]] to guard against a strike into the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="Warfare" /><ref name="Atlas" />

Wary of further Rebel strikes against key targets, Sate Pestage and the Ruling Council adopted a [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] strategy, fortifying key systems. This left the Rebellion, swiftly reconstituted as the [[Alliance of Free Planets]], largely unopposed. Additionally, this defensive strategy caused many of the Empire's most ambitious Moffs and governors to think only of the safety of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworlds]] and power bases, causing them to ''de facto'' break with the Ruling Council and become the first [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]]. Grand Moff [[Zsinj]] fortified his holdings in the [[Quelii Oversector]]. Tarkin's successor as the governor of [[Oversector Outer]], [[Ardus Kaine]], abandoned much of the Outer Rim to defend the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] in the north quadrant of the galaxy, forming the isolationist [[Pentastar Alignment]] around his homeworld of [[Bastion/Legends|Sartinaynian]]. From [[Centares/Legends|Centares]], Admiral [[Treuten Teradoc]] carved out the [[Greater Maldrood]]. Admiral [[Sander Delvardus]] proclaimed himself "[[Superior General]]" and established the [[Eriadu Authority]], seeking to secure the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] up to Yag'Dhul. Moff [[Par Lankin]] established his own fiefdom in the [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]]. In the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]], Grand Admiral [[Danetta Pitta]] bribed the [[diktat]] into appointing him "Protector" of the sector in preparation for a move against Coruscant. [[Utoxx Prentioch]] and [[Gaen Drommel]] fortified their home sectors of [[Sombure sector/Legends|Sombure]] and [[Oplovis sector/Legends|Oplovis]], while in the Deep Core, Harrsk established [[Zero Command]].<ref name="Warfare" /><ref name="Atlas" />

The [[Loyalist/Legends|Loyalist]] rump of the Imperial Starfleet that remained under Coruscant's control was led by capable officers like [[Betl Oxtroe]], [[Uther Kermen]], Gilad Pellaeon, and Soontir Fel. Kermen commanded the entire fleet, which in practice was loyal to him rather than the Ruling Council. Pellaeon was a popular and respected officer but never considered himself a candidate for leadership, seeing his role as being that as a steward of the fleet.<ref name="NEC" /> Fel was one of the Empire's greatest starfighter aces, a propaganda hero and a legend within the Empire. Fel's popularity and stature was such that, as the Galactic Empire's military situation deteriorated after Endor, Ysanne Isard suspected that a conspiracy of naval commanders was prepared to offer Fel the Imperial throne to replace her and Pestage.<ref name="Warfare" /><ref name="Characters">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>

[[File:Invaders_from_Beyond.png|thumb|left|300px|Map of Imperial fortress worlds and [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]]' territories in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], with the route of the [[Ssi-ruuvi invasions]] and the [[Nagai–Tof War]] also marked]]
Wary of re-unifying the disintegrating Empire, the Alliance of Free Planets opted for diplomacy over military action to win over sectors. Bothawui and [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] declared themselves for the Alliance, as did representatives from Corellia, [[Duro/Legends|Duro]], Kashyyyk, Sullust and [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]]. Others, like [[Herglic Space/Legends|Herglic Space]] and the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] and the [[Freeworlds Territory]] declared independence or neutrality, which the Alliance respected. A decisive moment was Mon Mothma issuing the [[Defense Declarations]], which proclaimed the Alliance's intent to devolve control of the [[Planetary Security Forces]], nationalized by the Empire, back to the sectors. Admiral Ackbar would later describe the Declarations as more decisive in delivering worlds from the Empire than any military campaign: members of the new government would be expected to support the common military, but could also now control their own planetary defense forces and at greater strength than under the Empire or the Republic. Imperial loyalist sectors dismissed the measure as illegal, but for others the Declarations caused many sectors that had been on the edge to side with the New Republic. Other sectors divided over whether to accept the Declarations, fomenting further [[Warlord/Legends|warlordism]] and infighting and significantly reducing the number of enemies the Alliance had to fight.<ref name="Warfare" /><ref name="Atlas" />

====The Ssi-ruuvi invasion====
{{Main|Ssi-ruuvi invasions|Bakura Truce}}
[[File:BattleoverBakura.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Battle of Bakura.]]
The Alliance's diplomatic approach was driven by the need to confront three new unexpected enemies that had arrived from the Unknown Regions. Just one day after the Battle of Endor, an Imperial [[Elegance message drone|Emissary Droid Ship]] arrived in the Forest Moon carrying a message from the Imperial outpost of Bakura, which was under attack by an unknown species from the Unknown Regions. In the chaos following the Emperor's death, no Imperial troops were available to come to its aid. In response, Mon Mothma gathered a small Rebel fleet to come to the defense of Bakura. Thus, Luke Skywalker was named the commander of a fleet of five [[DP20 gunship/Legends|Corellian gunships]], one modified [[Bulk cruiser/Legends|bulk cruiser]] ''[[Flurry]]'', 20 starfighters, and the ''Millennium Falcon''. Upon arriving, they discovered that the attackers were an unknown reptilian species called the [[Ssi-ruu]]k. The Ssi-ruuk practiced [[entechment]], which involved transferring the life energies of a captive into a battle droid, starship or computer.<ref name="Atlas" /><ref name="Truce at Bakura" />

At Bakura, the Rebel fleet signed a truce with the local Imperial garrison under [[Wilek Nereus]]. On the Ssi-ruuvi flagship [[Sibwarra|''Shriwirr'']], Admiral [[Ivpikkis]] prepared for battle. One of his officers owned a brainwashed [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] slave named [[Dev Sibwarra]], who sensed the presence of Luke and alerted his masters. The Ssi-ruuk had intended to use his Force abilities to entech beings by proxy. To do this, Dev Sibwarra secretly contacted the Imperial governor Nereus and offered to leave Bakura alone if they handed Skywalker over. Skywalker was captured by the Ssi-ruuk and brought to a laboratory where they intended to entech him. However, he broke free and together with Dev Sibwarra defeated the Ssi-ruuk aboard the ship. The Ssi-ruuk abandoned the ''Shriwirr'' rather than face the Jedi Knight in battle, and it was captured by the Rebel forces. The Ssi-ruuk were defeated, and then the Imperial Commander [[Pter Thanas]], under orders from Nereus, turned the turbolaser batteries of his flagship ''[[Dominant]]'' on the Rebel Alliance ship ''Flurry'', destroying it along with several Rebel starfighters. The Bakuran resistance cells, however, under leadership of [[Eppie Belden]], overthrew their Imperial rulers. The Imperial garrison on Bakura surrendered to the Rebel Alliance, and Bakura became a member of the fledgling Alliance of Free Planets. [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] later referred to the battle as the "Bakura Incident," and believed that it would be best if the New Republic attempted to prevent widespread public knowledge of the Ssi-ruuk&mdash;advice that was controversial at best.<ref name="Truce at Bakura" />

The Alliance sent a fleet consisting of Nebulon-B frigates and other smaller vessels under the captured ''Shriwirr'', which had been renamed ''Sibwarra'', into the [[Ssi-ruuk Star Cluster]] to counterattack. There, they discovered that the Ssi-ruuk had been attacked by an unknown foe, later revealed to be the Chiss Ascendancy. During an [[Assault on Lwhekk|assault on the Ssi-ruuvi capital]] of Lwhekk, the Alliance fleet engaged Ivpikkis's fleet though both sides eventually reached a standstill. Seeing a weakened foe, the fleet retreated and assisted in the [[liberation of Clak'dor VII]]. It wouldn't be until years later during the the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] that the Ssi-ruuk resurfaced.<ref name="Atlas" /><ref name="NEC" />

====The Nagai and the Tofs====
{{Quote|Run back to your friends, little Leia&hellip; but you have worse things to worry about than stormtroopers. Before long, you and everyone you hold dear will learn just how "pretty dangerous" a foe I can be.|[[Lumiya]]|<ref name="msw88">[[Star Wars (1977) 88|''Star Wars'' (1977) 88]]</ref>}}
{{Main|Nagai–Tof War}}
[[File:BHerdessa.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Lumiya leads forces on [[Herdessa/Legends|Herdessa]].]]
Following the Ssi-Ruuk came the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]], fleeing from the satellite galaxy [[Firefist|Companion Besh]], known to them as Firefist. The Nagai invaded the galaxy's [[southern quadrant]], assisted by stormtroopers loyal to the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adept]] [[Lumiya]]. They secured a forward base at [[Kinooine/Legends|Kinooine]] before moving on to [[Terminus/Legends|Terminus]] to gain access to the Hydian Way and the Corellian Trade Spine. The Nagai had an advantage in their [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computers]], which were far faster at calculating hyperspace jumps than standard galactic computers and utilized [[Tachyon/Legends|tachyonic]] observational sensors to map [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] hazards and landmarks much more efficiently than Imperial technology. Consequently, they were able to launch distant raids on Endor, [[Trenwyth/Legends|Trenwyth]] and [[Kabray]], and even reach as far as [[Iskalon/Legends|Iskalon]], [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] and [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]].<ref name="Warfare" /><ref name="Atlas" />

The Alliance of Free Planets prepared for war with the Nagai, but soon discovered that they were in fact fleeing another alien race, the [[Tof/Legends|Tofs]]. The Tofs had subjugated the Nagai in Firefist for centuries and had pursued them to the galaxy. The Tofs under [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Sereno]] established a base at [[Saijo/Legends|Saijo]] after devastating the [[Saijo sector/Legends|surrounding sector]], pursued the Nagai to Trenwyth and then tracked them to Zeltros, where they were [[Battle of Zeltros|defeated]] by a joint force of Alliance, Nagai, [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltrons]] and [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] under the command of [[Fenn Shysa]]. Concurrently, Luke Skywalker and the Alliance Star Destroyer ''[[Emancipator]]'' [[Battle of Saijo|raided Saijo]] and captured Prince Sereno. These two battles ended the invasion and the Nagai left the galaxy to reclaim their homeworld.<ref name="Warfare" /><ref name="Atlas" />

===The advance of the New Republic (4&ndash;6 ABY)===
====The Republic strategy====
{{Quote|We, the Beings of the galaxy, in order to form a free union of planets, establish justice, provide for common peace and prosperity, and to secure liberty for all being, do ordain and establish this New Republic. Let the stars sing! Let the planets shout! Let the Republic begin!|The [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|Declaration of a New Republic]]|<ref name="Chronology" />}}
[[File:New_Republic_Advances.png|thumb|right|300px|The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] advance to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] from [[4 ABY/Legends|4]] to [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]]]]
One month after Endor, the Alliance of Free Planets reorganized and issued the [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|Declaration of a New Republic]], proclaiming a new galactic government to replace the Empire. The document was signed by Mon Mothma, Leia Organa, Borsk Fey'lya, and Admiral Ackbar, as well as representatives from Corellia, [[Duros/Legends|Duro]], Kashyyyk, Sullust and [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]]. These nine beings comprised the [[New Republic Provisional Council]], with Mon Mothma being elected [[Chief Councilor]]. The expulsion of the Ssi-ruuvi, Nagai and Tof invasions had reassured citizens that the former Rebellion could defend the galaxy and legitimized the new government. Meanwhile, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] military leaders met on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] to plan the invasion of the Galactic Empire.<ref name="Warfare" />

The campaigns against the Ssi-ruuk, the Nagai, and the Tofs had stretched the Alliance of Free Planets to the breaking point,<ref name="Warfare" /> so the New Republic would not make any overt military moves until nearly six months after Endor. Instead, they consolidated their holdings and won over hundreds of planets through diplomacy. News of Palpatine's death caused many worlds in the Rim territories to defect to the New Republic. Rogue Squadron acted as scouts, escorts and negotiators in this period.<ref name="NEC" /> The nascent New Republic already had a number of advantages: the Empire had been split by both the [[Defense Declarations]] and warlordism, Ardus Kaine's powerful Pentastar Alignment remained isolationist, and the New Republic Intelligence Service's [[Alpha Blue|Shadow Operations]] under the command of [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] worked to exacerbate tensions within the Empire through sabotage, disinformation and assassination.<ref name="Warfare" />

To avoid re-unifying the Empire against a common enemy, Admiral Ackbar planned to isolate and marginalize the weaker Imperial warlords while Mon Mothma continued the campaign of diplomacy.<ref name="Atlas" /> Ackbar split his navy into four fleets: the [[New Republic First Fleet|First Fleet]] under the command of Admiral [[Firmus Nantz]] operated out of [[Saijo/Legends|Saijo]] in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]]; the [[New Republic Second Fleet|Second Fleet]] under Admiral [[Hiram Drayson/Legends|Hiram Drayson]] defended the New Republic's redoubt in the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]]; the [[New Republic Third Fleet|Third Fleet]] operated out of [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan Space]] into [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] under Ackbar's personal command; and the [[New Republic Fourth Fleet|Fouth Fleet]] under Admiral [[Voon Massa]] operated from Bothawui along the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] as a mobile reserve for the First and Third Fleets.<ref name="Warfare" />

====The early moves (4 ABY)====
{{Main|Hevvrol Sector Campaign|Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends}}
Moving from Saijo, Nantz' First Fleet moved against Delvardus and Prentioch. Nantz sent [[Lando's Commandos]] under the command of General Calrissian to [[Liberation of Bespin|liberate Bespin]] and then [[Operation on Abraxas|engage]] the [[Eiattu pirates]] at [[Abraxas]]. The victory in the [[Abraxas system/Legends|Abraxas system]] kept Prentioch fixed within [[Prentioch's Dominion|his territories]] around [[Bomis Koori IV]] and separated him from Delvardus' Eriadu Authority. Meanwhile, General [[Tyr Taskeen]] defeated Delvardus at the [[Battle of Glova]], which prevented him from linking up with Imperial forces Rimward in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood]] and [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos sectors]]. With Delvardus and Prentioch contained, Nantz [[Skirmish at Kriselist|skirmished with Prentioch]] at [[Kriselist/Legends|Kriselist]] before bypassing him and [[Battle of Moorja (Galactic Civil War)|securing]] a new forward base at [[Moorja/Legends|Moorja]]. First Fleet then moved [[Spinward]] via [[Bannistar Station]] to [[Glom Tho]], where it began the [[Hevvrol Sector Campaign]] against Par Lankin. The [[Battle of Glom Tho]] saw the capture of several key manufacturing facilities by Taskeen's forces and successfully isolated the [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]], which held out until [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] before it surrendered. From Glom Tho, Nantz captured [[Kalarba/Legends|Kalarba]]. Meanwhile, Voon Massa's Fourth Fleet moved from Bothawui to the key industrial world of [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]], before moving up the Corellian Run to link up with the First Fleet.<ref name="Warfare" /><ref name="Atlas" />

Emboldened by their successes, Ackbar's Third Fleet moved to [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|liberate Kashyyyk]]: the planet was at the crossroads of six major hyperspace routes that could support a strike into the Core, and [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Hindane Darcc/Legends|Hindane Darcc]] had made a deal with [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] leader [[Pekt]] to eliminate the Wookiee population of the planet. Han Solo and Chewbacca inserted on to Kashyyyk to stop Darcc and fought a campaign by both land and sea to destroy Imperial communications [[Jammer/Legends|jammers]]. After destroying the signal jammers they sent a transmission to the New Republic, which was received by Lando Calrissian, before ascending to the [[Avatar Orbital Platform]] above Kashyyyk, where they killed Moff Darcc and Pekt.<ref name="Galactic Battlegrounds" /> In orbit, meanwhile, Ackbar's Third Fleet squared off with and destroyed an Imperial fleet under Grand Admiral [[Peccati Syn]].<ref name="Warfare" /><ref name="Atlas" />

====The Battle of Brentaal IV (4 ABY)====
{{Main|Battle of Brentaal IV (Galactic Civil War)}}
[[File:Battle_of_Brentaal_IV.jpg|thumb|left|200px|New Republic starfighters and Imperial stormtroopers during the Battle of Brentaal IV.]]
From Kashyyyk, Rogue Squadron moved via [[Base Delta-Nine]] at [[Recopia]] to attack [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]], the crossroads of the Hydian Way and the Perlemian Trade Route. The [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Brentaal IV]] was a propaganda struggle by both the Republic and the Empire: nine months after Endor, the New Republic needed to show its hand in the Core while Sate Pestage and the Imperial Ruling Council needed to show that the Empire was still powerful after the loss at Endor. However, the machinations of Ysanne Isard and the incompetence of Admiral [[Lon Isoto]] meant that Brentaal was lost to the New Republic and the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] ace [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] Soontir Fel was captured by the Rogues. On Coruscant, Pestage's position collapsed, and he began secret negotiations with the New Republic, offering them Coruscant in exchange for immunity. Isard exposed his dealings, and Pestage was forced to flee to the [[Ciutric Hegemony]].<ref name="Mandatory Retirement" /> Isard, meanwhile, proclaimed herself Empress and massacred much of the Ruling Council.<ref name="Warfare" /><ref name="Atlas" /> An effort by Rogue Squadron to [[Evacuation of Ciutric|rescue]] Pestage from [[Ciutric IV]] failed, and the former Grand Vizier was murdered by [[Delak Krennel]].<ref name="Mandatory Retirement" />

====The Hast Raid (4 ABY)====
[[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] was less successful for the New Republic Second Fleet. Hiram Drayson and his three Mon Calamari subordinates, [[Kalback]], [[Nammo]] and [[Ragab]], won an initial [[Battle of Emmer (4 ABY)|battle]] at [[Emmer]] and isolated the fortress world of [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]], but their plans for a push down the Hydian Way were derailed by an Imperial [[Battle of the Hast Shipyards|raid]] on the secret [[Hast Shipyards]]. Admiral [[Llon Banjeer]] destroyed or damaged more than thirty New Republic capital ships in the raid, halting New Republic plans for attacks on Zsinj and Teradoc. Concurrent to the New Republic's operations was the [[Yevethan Uprising]], where [[Yevetha]] slaves seized the [[Black Fifteen]] shipyards over [[N'zoth]] and massacred or enslaved the Imperial crew. The newly armed Yevetha would emerge from the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]] twelve years later in the [[Black Fleet Crisis]].<ref name="Warfare" /><ref name="Atlas" />

====Milagro and Trioculus (5 ABY)====
{{Main|Milagro campaign|Trioculus affair|Stenax Massacres}}
[[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] began with Massa's Fourth Fleet pushing up the Corellian Run and engaging in the three-month [[Milagro campaign]], which ended when Imperial Admiral Uther Kermen launched a [[Base Delta Zero/Legends|Base Delta Zero]] operation on the planet to deny its manufacturing facilities to the New Republic. Kerman regrouped at [[Spirana/Legends|Spirana]] before [[Battle in the Milagro system|raiding Milagro]] again, where Mon Mothma was meeting Fourth Fleet's commanders and establishing a new headquarters. Massa repelled the raid and [[Battle of Spirana|counterattacked]], seizing Spirana and gaining a foothold in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. For his conduct in the defense of the [[Milagro system/Legends|Milagro system]], Luke Skywalker was promoted to the rank of general.<ref name="Warfare" /><ref name="Atlas" />

In the north, Admiral Drayson's Second Fleet sortied in an effort to stop the [[Stenax]] people slaughtering Imperial military personnel and civilians alike in the [[Thanium sector/Legends|Thanium Worlds]], the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]], and the [[Spadja sector/Legends|Spadja sector]]. The [[Stenax Massacres]] were halted by the Second Fleet at the [[Battle of Tharkos]], though only after the loss of millions of lives.<ref name="Warfare" /><ref name="Atlas" />

5 ABY was also marked by the [[Trioculus affair]], in which the self-proclaimed [[Central Committee of Grand Moffs]] led by [[Bertroff Hissa]] attempted to pass off the three-eyed [[mutant]] Human [[Trioculus]] as Emperor Palpatine's [[Triclops|illegitimate son]] in an effort to wrest power away from Empress Ysanne Isard. The scheme was in fact a sham orchestrated from afar by Darth Sidious, who used it to distract from his period of rebirth into a clone body on Byss. [[Trioculus' Empire]] ultimately fell apart owing to infighting with the [[Rajah Ubooki|false Supreme Prophet]] "[[Kadann]]" and ended with Trioculus' assassination by a New Republic [[Human replica droid]] [[Leia Organa II|disguised as Princess Leia]].<ref name="Jedi Prince">''[[Adventures of a Jedi Prince]]'' series</ref> The crisis also saw the deaths of Grand Admirals [[Danetta Pitta]] and [[Josef Grunger]], whose fleets suffered mutual annihilation at the [[Battle of Tralus (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Tralus]], where Grunger attempted to claim the system for the Central Committee in preparation for a drive towards Coruscant,<ref name="Who's Who" /> while Grand Admirals [[Miltin Takel]] and [[Rufaan Tigellinus]] had been executed by Trioculus after falling afoul of the Committee. The Grand Moffs involved in the conspiracy were executed, strengthening Isard's position as head of the Empire.<ref name="NEC" />

====The Battle of Mindor (5 ABY)====
{{Main|Battle of Mindor}}
[[File:PrereleaseMindorCoverArt.jpg|thumb|right|220px|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] during the [[Battle of Mindor]]]]
The same year saw the Third Fleet, detached to the command of [[Kalback]] and [[Willham Burke]], move from Kashyyyk against Warlord Teradoc. The Third Fleet [[Battle of Togoria (Galactic Civil War)|halted]] an advance by Teradoc at [[Togoria/Legends|Togoria]] and secured [[Lantillies/Legends|Lantillies]] and [[Contruum/Legends|Contruum]], gaining the New Republic a beachhead on the Perlemian Trade Route. Burke then pursued Admiral [[Ledre Okins]]' fleet along the Perlemian Trade Route, eventually defeating him at the [[Battle of Colla]] and opening the way to the New Republic salient at Brentaal.<ref name="Warfare" /><ref name="Atlas" />

However, Kalback's attempt to drive up the Hydian Way was halted at the [[Battle of Corsin (5 ABY)|Battle of Corsin]], where Warlord Zsinj's [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']] drove him into retreat. Kalback regrouped at [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]], where he joined forces with General Luke Skywalker's [[Rapid Response Task Force]] to eliminate the forces of [[Cronal|Lord Shadowspawn]], whose [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]] had been launching damaging raids from [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]] into the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] and [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Battle of Mindor]] was a protracted and bloody series of engagements that left thousands dead, including Kalback, despite the New Republic's eventual victory. The casualties prompted Skywalker to resign from the [[New Republic Army]] and concentrate on the [[New Jedi Order|restoration of the Jedi Order]].<ref name="Warfare" /><ref name="Atlas" />

====The Delvardus campaign (5 ABY)====
{{Main|Delvardus campaign}}
Elswhere, Firmus Nantz' First Fleet moved from Moorja to [[Battle of Yag'Dhul (Galactic Civil War)|capture Yag'Dhul]], before moving on to Thyferra and liberating [[Cilpar]] and [[Mrlsst/Legends|Mrlsst]] and opening negotiations with the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglics]], who had declared themselves neutral. Behind his lines in the Outer Rim, a desperate Warlord Delvardus attempted to break out with an [[Battle of Sullust (Delvardus campaign)|attack on Sullust]], but was defeated by First Fleet elements under the command of Captain [[Sien Sovv]]. With his Coreward front secure, Nantz sent a task force back down the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] to counterattack Delvardus.<ref name="Warfare" /><ref name="Atlas" />

The [[Delvardus campaign]] rapidly collapsed the borders of the Eriadu Authority with rapid attacks on [[Sanrafsix/Legends|Sanrafsix]], [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]], [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]] and [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]] (the task force here reinforced by the fleet ordered to return from [[Lwhekk/Legends|Lwhekk]] after pursuing the [[Ssi-ruu]]k). Delvardus fled to the Imperial redoubt in the Deep Core, though [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] itself would not surrender to the New Republic until [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]. The rapid campaign provided a needed boost to Republic morale after the attritional slogs of Milagro and Mindor.<ref name="Warfare" /><ref name="Atlas" />

====Consolidation (6 ABY)====
In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], the New Republic consolidated its holdings. Nantz attacked and captured Prentioch at the [[Siege of Bomis Koori]] and eliminated his dominion, securing the entire [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]]. The Fourth Fleet [[Battle of Denon (Galactic Civil War)|captured Denon]] in a fierce battle that saw the death of Admiral Massa, advancing the Corellian Run front to the edge of the Colonies. From Kashyyyk, Admiral Ackbar led Third Fleet in the capture of [[Battle of Reytha|Reytha]], which forced the Empire to abandon [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]] and [[Cyrillia/Legends|Cyrillia]]. Ackbar then moved the encircle the Core, moving north up the Hydian Way to push back Zsinj and cut Coruscant off from the Imperial Loyalist systems in the New Territories and the Pentastar Alignment. Third Fleet won battles at [[Uviuy Exen/Legends|Uviuy Exen]] and [[Drearia/Legends|Drearia]], but Admiral [[Ragab]] was halted by Zsinj's [[Raptors]] at the [[Battle of Paqualis]].<ref name="Warfare" /><ref name="Atlas" />

Ackbar switched his advance to [[Palanhi/Legends|Palanhi]] in preparation for an advance on Coruscant down the [[Namadii Corridor/Legends|Namadii Corridor]]. Admiral [[Nammo]] aboard the [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']] was sent to capture the [[Bilbringi Shipyards]] secure the Republic's Rimward flank against the Imperial Loyalists in the north, but he was [[Battle of Bilbringi (6 ABY)|defeated]] by Admiral [[Teren Rogriss]] and [[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir's]] 181st Imperial Fighter Group. As the year drew to a close, the New Republic had kept the Pentastar Alignment isolated, had marginalized Teradoc, and had driven up to the Core Worlds. However, Isard still held a number of significant Core fortress worlds in addition to Coruscant, among them [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] and Balmorra, and Zsinj had emerged as a dangerous opponent.<ref name="Warfare" /><ref name="Atlas" />

====The fall of Coruscant (6 ABY)====
{{Main|Core Campaign|Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)}}
By the middle of [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], the New Republic had encircled the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and was finally in a position to seize Coruscant from Imperial rule.<ref name="NEC" /> The New Republic realized the importance of Coruscant beyond its mere designation as "000" in galactic charts. The planet was the most densely populated [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] in the galaxy and controlled two of the galaxy's five most heavily trafficked [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroutes]]. Possession of the system would massively increase the New Republic's legitimacy.<ref name="Atlas" />

[[File:Coruscant_Campaign.jpg|thumb|left|300px|New Republic fleet movements up to the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|Liberation of Coruscant]]]]
